marca.titulo: Issue electronic receipts without the hassle.
marca.subtitulo: Invoices, credit and debit notes, and voided document notices, in UBL 2.1 and with SUNAT validation rules.

login.subtitulo: Sign in to your account to continue.
login.soloPorInvitacion: Access is by invitation while the beta lasts.

registro.ayudaTelefono: We will contact you if there is any problem with your account. 9 digits, starting with 9.
registro.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
registro.terminosRequeridos: To create your account you must accept the terms of service and the privacy policy.

recuperar.subtitulo: We will send you a link to reset it.
recuperar.confirmacion: If the email is registered, we sent you a link to reset your password.

restablecer.subtitulo: Enter your new password to continue.
restablecer.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
restablecer.exito: Your password was updated. You can now sign in.

invitacion.subtitulo: We signed you up for khipu. Choose the password you will use to sign in.
invitacion.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
invitacion.exito: Your password is ready. You can now sign in.
invitacion.enlaceInvalido: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.

verificar.subtitulo: Confirm that this email is yours to start issuing.
verificar.exito: Your email is verified. You can now set up your company and start issuing.
verificar.enlaceInvalido: The verification link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. Sign in and request another.

aceptarInvitacion.subtitulo: Create your password to sign in.
aceptarInvitacion.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
aceptarInvitacion.exito: Done: you are now part of the team. Sign in with your email and the password you chose.
aceptarInvitacion.enlaceInvalido: The invitation link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. Ask the person who invited you to resend it.

revisaTuCorreo.descripcion: We sent a link to {email} to verify that it is yours. Open it to set up your company and start issuing: until then you can look around the portal, but you cannot create or issue anything.
revisaTuCorreo.reenviado: We sent you another link. Check your spam folder too.

segundoFactor.verificarDescripcion: Open your authenticator app and enter the code it shows for khipu.
segundoFactor.verificarRecuperacionDescripcion: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works only once.
segundoFactor.configurarDescripcion: The backoffice can see the tax data of all customers, so to sign in you need, in addition to your password, a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
segundoFactor.configurarPaso1: Scan this QR code with the app.
segundoFactor.configurarSecreto: Can’t scan it? Enter this key in the app:
segundoFactor.configurarPaso2: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
segundoFactor.configurarQrAlt: QR code to add khipu to your authenticator app
segundoFactor.codigosDescripcion: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are not shown again: copy or print them and keep them somewhere other than your phone.

inicio.descripcion: Everything managed on the platform, grouped the same way as the menu.

resumen.cuentas: Registered customers: sign-up, plan, payments, status, and user access.
resumen.empresas: Every RUC on the platform: environment, certificate, SOL credentials, and API keys.
resumen.planes: What you sell: price and limits of each plan.
resumen.consumo: How much each account used this month against its plan cap.
resumen.monitor: How issuing is going over the last 24 hours and whether SUNAT is responding.
resumen.errores: Documents with problems across all customers, from most to least urgent.
resumen.avisos: Certificates about to expire and rejected SOL credentials, so you can warn customers in time.
resumen.integridad: Checks that the stored XML and CDR files are still the signed ones.
resumen.configuracion: Sender, email templates, and maintenance notice.

cuentas.buscar: Search by email, name, RUC or business name
cuentas.error: Could not load the list of accounts.

empresas.descripcion: All companies on the platform and whether they are able to issue.
empresas.buscar: Search by RUC or business name

columnas.delMesAyuda: All documents issued this month, accepted or not. What counts toward the plan (what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided) is under Usage.

empresas.error: Could not load the list of companies.

planes.descripcion: What is sold: the price and limits of each plan, and how many accounts have it. Changing a limit applies to the next cycle (the calendar month in Lima), not the one in progress.
planes.error: Could not load the list of plans.
planes.porDefectoAyuda: This is the plan every new account starts with: it cannot be deactivated or deleted.
planes.noPublicadoAyuda: Custom plan: it can be assigned and billed, but it does not appear on the pricing page.
planes.programadoAyuda: This limit change is not in effect yet: it starts at the beginning of the next cycle.

formulario.descripcionNuevo: It starts active and can be assigned to accounts right away.
formulario.descripcionEditar: Change the plan name, price or limits.
efectosNuevo: The plan is offered from the moment you create it.
The name cannot be repeated, regardless of capitalization.
efectosEditar: The name and price change immediately.
The new limits take effect on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle: raising or lowering a limit mid-month does not change this month and does not cut anyone off.
Accounts that already have the plan are not affected.
formulario.hayProgramado: You are seeing the limits already scheduled (from {fecha}). If you set today’s limits again, the change is canceled.
formulario.precioAyuda: In soles, with up to two decimals. Zero for a free plan.
formulario.visible: Show it on the pricing page
formulario.visibleAyuda: Uncheck it for a custom plan for one customer: it is assigned and billed all the same, but not published.

errores.nombreLargo: The name can be up to 40 characters.
errores.precioInvalido: Enter a price of zero or more (up to 99,999,999.99), with up to two decimals.
errores.limiteInvalido: Enter a whole number greater than zero, or check “Unlimited”.
errores.numeroInvalido: Enter a whole number greater than zero.

desactivar.descripcion: Takes it off the market without affecting those who already have it.
efectos: It stops being offered: it can no longer be assigned to new accounts.
It can be offered again whenever you want.
desactivar.cuentasUna: The account that has it keeps it: its subscription does not change.
desactivar.cuentasVarias: The {n} accounts that have it keep it: their subscriptions do not change.

activar.descripcion: Puts it back on the market.
efectos: It can be assigned to accounts again.
It does not change the accounts that already have it.

eliminar.descripcion: Only a plan that no one has ever used can be deleted.
efectos: The plan is deleted forever, along with its scheduled limit change if it has one.
If any account has ever had it, it cannot be deleted: it has to be deactivated.

consumo.descripcion: How much each account used during the month against the cap of its current plan, to warn before it hits the limit or runs out of service. It counts what SUNAT accepted, even if it was later voided, by issue date, in the Lima calendar month.
consumo.ayudaPlanDeHoy: Compared against each account’s current plan, even for a past month.
consumo.ayudaAlerta: Near the limit: from {umbral} % of the monthly document cap.

vacio.CERCA_DEL_LIMITE: No account is near its limit this month.
vacio.PLAN_VENCIDO: No account has an expired plan.

consumo.error: Could not load the accounts’ usage.

planDeCuenta.error: Could not load the account plan.
planDeCuenta.cubreHasta: Service continues until {fecha}, grace period included.
planDeCuenta.programado: Moves to {plan} on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle. Until then it stays on {actual}.

dialogo.descripcion: Upgrades take effect now; downgrades, at the start of the next cycle.
dialogo.pagadoHastaAyuda: Required on a paid plan. A free plan does not expire.
dialogo.graciaAyuda: How long service continues after expiration: 0 to 90 days.
dialogo.errorPrevia: Could not calculate what would happen.
dialogo.efectoCicloSiguiente: Takes effect on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle. Until then the account stays on {actual}.
dialogo.consumo: In {mes} the account used {n} documents (this counts what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided). The {plan} plan allows {limite} per month.
dialogo.consumoSinTope: In {mes} the account used {n} documents (this counts what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided). The {plan} plan has no document cap.
dialogo.superaInmediato: It already exceeds that cap: with an immediate change, the account would be over its limit for this month.
dialogo.superaBajada: Nothing changes this month: until the next cycle the account stays on its current plan.
dialogo.descartaInmediato: Cancels the move to {plan} scheduled for {fecha}: the account stays on the new plan.
dialogo.descartaBajada: Replaces the move to {plan} scheduled for {fecha}.

errores.vencimientoRequerido: A paid plan needs the date through which it is paid.
errores.vencimientoPasado: The date must be today or later.

pagos.descripcion: This account’s payments that were recorded by hand. There is no automatic charging: this is the trail of what the customer paid.
pagos.vacio: No payment has been recorded yet.
pagos.error: Could not load the account’s payments.

dialogo.descripcion: Record what the customer has already paid. It goes into the history and the audit log; it does not charge anything.
dialogo.montoAyuda: In soles, with up to two decimals.
dialogo.referenciaAyuda: Operation number. With a reference, the same method with the same reference cannot be recorded twice.
dialogo.extender: Extend the plan expiration to the end of the period
dialogo.extenderHoy: Today it is paid through {actual}; it would move to {nuevo}.
dialogo.extenderNoVence: This account’s plan does not expire: there is no expiration to extend.
dialogo.extenderNoAdelanta: The account is already paid through {actual}: this period does not move the expiration forward.
dialogo.extenderSinPlan: The account’s plan could not be loaded, so the expiration cannot be extended from here.
dialogo.extenderElegirPeriodo: Choose the end of the period to see the new expiration.

errores.desdeRequerido: Enter the date the payment starts covering.
errores.hastaRequerido: Enter the date the payment covers through.
errores.periodoAlReves: The period cannot end before it starts.
errores.periodoLargo: The period cannot exceed one year.
errores.montoInvalido: The amount must be greater than zero, with up to two decimals.
errores.fechaFutura: The payment date cannot be in the future.
errores.extenderSinEfecto: This period does not move the expiration forward: uncheck the extension or fix the period.

integridad.descripcion: Checks that the stored XML and CDR files are still the ones that were signed. Read-only: it repairs nothing. The same sweep runs daily over the last few days.
integridad.ayudaRango: By issue date, up to {max} days at a time.
integridad.avisoVerificando: Checking the documents in the range. It can take a while if there are many; do not close the page.

resultado.verificadosNinguno: There were no signed documents between {desde} and {hasta}.

tiposAyuda.XML_FALTANTE: The document is signed but its XML is no longer in storage.
tiposAyuda.XML_CORRUPTO: The XML exists but does not contain the DigestValue it was signed with, or it is truncated.
tiposAyuda.CDR_FALTANTE: SUNAT responded but its CDR is no longer in storage.
tiposAyuda.STORAGE_INACCESIBLE: Storage could not be read: it may be a connection failure rather than a lost object. It is worth running the check again.

errores.desdeRequerido: Enter the start of the range to verify.
errores.hastaRequerido: Enter the end of the range to verify.
errores.alReves: The range cannot end before it starts.

monitor.descripcion: How issuance is going for all customers: the documents from the last 24 hours, the SUNAT submission queue, and whether SUNAT is responding. It refreshes on its own every 30 seconds.
monitor.errorAlActualizar: Could not refresh the monitor. Showing the last reading.
monitor.sesionTerminada: Your session ended. Reload the page to sign in again.

alerta.uno: There is 1 overdue submission and it has been waiting {tiempo}. The job that empties the queue is probably not running.
alerta.varios: There are {n} overdue submissions and the longest-waiting one has been waiting {tiempo}. The job that empties the queue is probably not running.

alertaResumenes.titulo: Some SUNAT procedures have no response
alertaResumenes.uno: 1 daily summary or voiding request has gone {tiempo} without a response from SUNAT (limit: {umbral} h).
alertaResumenes.varios: {n} daily summaries or voiding requests have gone more than {umbral} h without a response from SUNAT; the oldest, {tiempo}.
alertaResumenes.ayuda: khipu keeps asking for its ticket (every 5 minutes at most) and does not give up, so it will not resolve on its own: check the ticket in SUNAT. In the meantime the receipt or document stays submitted, accepting neither voiding nor notes.

alertaBoletas.titulo: Some receipts have not been reported to SUNAT
alertaBoletas.uno: 1 receipt has gone 5 days or more without being reported; the oldest was issued on {fecha}.
alertaBoletas.varios: {n} receipts have gone 5 days or more without being reported; the oldest was issued on {fecha}.
alertaBoletas.urgente: 1 is on day 7 or already past it.
alertaBoletas.urgentes: {n} are on day 7 or already past it.
alertaBoletas.ayuda: Nobody else sends them: the customer left them unsent or their submission is failing. The daily summary accepts them up to day 7; after that they are reported late and SUNAT may flag them. Let the customer know.

hoy.tasaAyuda: Rejected out of those SUNAT has already resolved.

categoriasAyuda.aceptados: Accepted by SUNAT, with or without observations.
categoriasAyuda.conError: Did not arrive: submission error or past the deadline.
categoriasAyuda.enCamino: Signed, submitted, or waiting for the daily summary.

horas.ayuda: Documents created per hour, in Lima time.
horas.sinDatos: No document was created in the last 24 hours.
horas.grafico: Documents created per hour in the last 24 hours

outbox.ayuda: Submissions to SUNAT waiting to go out. A scheduled retry does not count as overdue.
outbox.masAntiguo: The oldest has been waiting since
outbox.vencidoHace: The longest-waiting one has been waiting {tiempo}.

sunat.ayuda: Whether each service responds. The reading is cached for 30 seconds and does not submit any document.

errores.descripcion: Problem documents from all customers, from most to least urgent: sending error, format error, past deadline and unsent receipt, with the SUNAT fault and the attempts. Only a sending error can be retried or discarded; the others are already terminal or are up to the customer.

ayudaClase.ERROR_DE_ENVIO: SUNAT did not respond or failed. It retries on its own.
ayudaClase.ERROR_DE_FORMATO: SUNAT rejected it with a fault 1000–1999: retrying will not change that.
ayudaClase.FUERA_DE_PLAZO: It did not arrive within the sending deadline: it has to be issued again.
ayudaClase.BOLETA_SIN_ENVIAR: A receipt the customer left unsent that is already 5 days old or more. Nothing failed, but the daily summary closes on day 7: let them know.

errores.decisionDelCliente: Sending it is the customer’s decision: let them know

vacio.TODAS: There are no problem documents. All clear.
vacio.FUERA_DE_PLAZO: There are no documents past the deadline.

errores.vacioConBusqueda: No problem document matches the search.
errores.error: Could not load the error queue.

efectos: Sends the document to SUNAT now, with its company’s credentials.
If SUNAT fails again, it stays as a sending error and keeps retrying on its own.
If it is no longer pending or the deadline has passed, it is not sent and you are notified.
It is recorded in the audit log.

descarte.efectoConsultaSunat: In production, SUNAT is asked first whether it already received it: if it has it, its response is applied and the document is not discarded.
descarte.efectoSinConsultaSunat: SUNAT does not allow looking up receipts or receipt notes by series and number: it cannot be asked whether it already received this one. If the submission was cut off after SUNAT accepted it, discarding it leaves two receipts for the same sale; when in doubt, retry the submission.
efectos: The document is discarded: it is never sent again, neither automatically nor manually. This cannot be undone.
The customer has to issue a new one; this one’s number stays consumed.
It is removed from the sending queue and from this list.
It is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
descarte.ayudaMotivo: Required. It is recorded in the audit log. Up to {max} characters.

avisos.descripcion: Companies that need to be warned about something before they can no longer issue: an expiring or expired certificate, and SOL credentials that SUNAT does not accept. The notice is emailed to the account; the same notice is not repeated within a week.
avisos.sinCertificado: Companies that never uploaded their certificate also cannot issue, but they have nothing to expire and do not appear here.

ayuda.CERTIFICADOS: Certificates that expire in less than 30 days or have already expired, from most to least urgent.
ayuda.CREDENCIALES_SOL: Inferred from submissions that are failing now: a company that is not issuing does not appear, and one that has already resubmitted successfully drops off on its own.

avisos.sinCuenta: No account: there is no one to notify

vacio.CERTIFICADOS: No certificate expires in the next 30 days. All good.
vacio.CREDENCIALES_SOL: No company has submissions stuck because of its SOL credentials.

avisos.error: Could not load the list of notices.

efectos: Sends an email to {correo}: {que}.
The same notice is not repeated within a week, even if another administrator clicks at the same time.
It is recorded in the audit log, without the customer’s email.

que.CERTIFICADO_POR_VENCER: that their digital certificate is about to expire
que.CERTIFICADO_VENCIDO: that their digital certificate has expired and they cannot issue
que.CREDENCIALES_SOL_INVALIDAS: that SUNAT does not accept their SOL credentials

configuracion.descripcion: What changes what customers see and receive, without waiting for a deployment. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

correo.ayuda: Takes effect from the next email, with no restart. The mail server (SMTP) must accept sending from that address (verified sender, SPF and DKIM): this cannot be checked from here.
correo.nombreAyuda: Optional. How the sender appears in the customer’s inbox.
correo.responderAyuda: Optional. If left empty, replies go back to the sender.
correo.delServidor: This is the one from the server configuration: nobody has changed it from here.
correo.guardado: Sender saved: it takes effect from the next email.

restablecer.descripcion: Emails go back to being sent from the sender in the server configuration.
efectos: Removes the sender set here, and emails go back to being sent from {remitente}.
Takes effect from the next email. It does not change the email texts.
It is recorded in the audit log.

plantillas.ayuda: The text of each email the platform sends. Anything not changed goes out with the default text. Takes effect from the next email.
plantillas.variablesAyuda: They are written between braces and replaced when the email is sent. Click to insert one where the cursor is.
plantillas.vistaPreviaTitulo: This is how it would look, with sample values
plantillas.guardado: Text saved: it takes effect from the next email.
plantillas.deFabrica: It goes out with the default text.

restaurar.descripcion: The email “{correo}” goes back to being sent with its default text.
efectos: Deletes the text written here: it cannot be undone, but it can be written again.
Takes effect from the next email.
It is recorded in the audit log (without the text).

aviso.ayuda: A notice that all customers see at the top of their portal, also before signing in. It always has an end: it hides itself. Times are Lima time.
aviso.textoAyuda: A single line, up to {max} characters. It is shown as plain text.
aviso.hastaAyuda: Required, and at most {dias} days after it starts.
aviso.retirado: Notice withdrawn: it is no longer shown to anyone.
aviso.vistaPrevia: This is how customers will see it

estado.vencido: It has already expired: not shown.

retirar.descripcion: It stops being shown to customers right now.
efectos: Customers stop seeing the notice as soon as they reload their portal.
To show it again, it has to be published again.
It is recorded in the audit log.

darDeBaja.descripcion: {nombre} is removed from the lists and from billing. Nothing is deleted and it can be reversed.
efectos: The account and its companies stop appearing in the lists unless you ask to see them.
Documents, XML and CDR are kept, and its RUC stays taken: no one else will be able to register it.
It does not cut off access: its users can still sign in and its API keys can still issue. To cut off service, suspend the account.
Restoring the account brings it back to the lists.
darDeBaja.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. Up to 200 characters; never write passwords or API keys.

reponer.descripcion: {nombre} returns to the lists and to billing.
efectos: The account and its companies appear in the lists again.
Nothing else changes: if it was suspended, it stays suspended until you reactivate it.

suspender.descripcion: This cuts off service for {nombre} right now. Nothing is deleted and it can be reversed.
efectos: None of its users will be able to sign in to the portal, even with a session already open.
None of its companies will be able to issue or query through the API: their API keys will respond “account suspended”.
Documents already issued will keep being sent to SUNAT: stopping them would put them past the deadline.
Reactivating the account restores everything as it was, with the same sessions and API keys.
suspender.motivoAyuda: Saved in the audit log. Up to 200 characters; never write passwords or API keys.

efectos: Its users can sign in to the portal again, with the sessions they already had.
Its companies can issue through the API again, with the same API keys.
From this moment it issues against SUNAT production: the documents it issues are real.
It needs the production SOL credentials and certificate: test (beta) ones will be rejected.
It does not affect documents already issued.
It cannot be changed while it has pending submissions to SUNAT: what was issued in one environment must not be sent to the other.
It is recorded in the audit log, from which environment to which.
From this moment it issues against the SUNAT test environment: the documents it issues have no validity.
It does not affect documents already issued.
It cannot be changed while it has pending submissions to SUNAT: what was issued in one environment must not be sent to the other.
It is recorded in the audit log, from which environment to which.
It stops authenticating immediately: integrations that use it will start receiving 401.
The company’s other keys keep working.
It cannot be undone: another key would have to be created.
It is recorded in the audit log with its prefix, never the key itself.

conexion.sinSol: Without SOL credentials there is nothing to test with.
conexion.nota: The test asks SUNAT about a ticket that does not exist, using the company’s SOL credentials and environment: it is read-only and sends nothing. With a ticket that does not exist, a ticket error is expected; what the test tells you is whether SUNAT responded. It is recorded in the audit log.

resultados.SIN_RESPUESTA: There was no useful response from SUNAT.

comprobanteDetalle.ayudaIntentos: Counts the submissions that failed: one that SUNAT received on the first try shows 0.
comprobanteDetalle.ayudaArchivos: It only says whether they exist: their content belongs to the customer and is downloaded from their dashboard.

bajas.ayuda: The voiding communication (RA) for an invoice or the daily summary (RC) for a receipt or a receipt note, from newest to oldest. Read-only.
bajas.motivoSoloKhipu: Kept only in khipu: the daily summary does not carry it.

fiscales.sinDomicilio: They have not declared their registered address yet.

conexion.nota: It is only known whether they are uploaded: their contents never leave the backend.

apiKeys.vacio: This company has no API keys.
apiKeys.nota: Only the prefix: the secret is never shown.

comprobantes.vacio: It has not issued any documents yet.

eventos.vacio: Recent documents have no status changes.

historial.descripcion: Every suspension, reactivation, closure, and restoration of the account, with who did it and why.
historial.vacio: The account has never changed status.

impersonar.titulo: Sign in to the portal as this user
impersonar.descripcion: You will see the portal exactly as {correo} sees it.
efectos: The session lasts 15 minutes and cannot be renewed: to keep looking, you have to sign in again.
You can only look: you cannot change anything (not the password, SOL credentials, API keys, or issue documents).
It is recorded in the audit log under your name, and the customer sees it in their support access history, without your name.
It replaces the customer session you have open in this browser.

restablecer.descripcion: A link to choose a new password is sent to {correo}.
efectos: You neither see nor set the password: the link goes only to that person.
Their current password stays valid until they use the link.
It is recorded in the account audit log.

verificar.descripcion: The link to verify their email is sent again to {correo}.
efectos: The email carries a new link; only that person can use it.
It is recorded in the account audit log.

empresas.vacio: This account has no companies yet.

eventos.vacio: No administrator has acted on this account.

acciones.ACTIVAR_PLAN: Put a plan back on sale
acciones.AVISAR_AL_CLIENTE: Customer notified about their certificate or SOL password
acciones.RESTAURAR_PLANTILLA_DE_CORREO: Restored an email to its default text

alta.descripcion: Onboard a customer: their account, their first company, and their first series. The customer receives an invitation by email and chooses their own password; you never set it.
alta.subtituloCuenta: Who uses the portal and where the invitation goes
alta.subtituloEmpresa: The one that will issue the documents
alta.subtituloSerie: The one they will use to issue their first document
alta.nombreAyuda: The person or business that signs up. This is how it appears in Accounts.
alta.emailAyuda: They sign in to the portal with this email; the invitation to create their password is sent here.
alta.serieAyuda: For example F001 for invoices or B001 for receipts (SUNAT 1001).
alta.sesionExpirada: Your administrator session expired. Sign in again.
alta.corteDeConexion: The connection dropped while onboarding. Submit again without changing anything: if the onboarding already went through, you will see the same API key, without creating another account.

resultado.descripcion: The account, the company, and the series have been created.
resultado.avisoApiKey: Hand it to the customer now: it will not be shown again. Only a hash is kept, so if it is lost they will have to revoke it and create another one from their portal.
resultado.invitacionEnviada: We sent the invitation to {email}. With that link the customer creates their password and signs in.
resultado.invitacionNoEnviada: We could not send the invitation to {email}. The onboarding is done: the customer can request a link from “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.

errores.correoLargo: The email can be up to 254 characters
errores.nombreLargo: The name can be up to 150 characters

recargar.estado: {error} Reload the page to see the current state.
recargar.estadoDeLaCuenta: {error} Reload the page to see the current state of the account.
recargar.pagoRegistrado: {error} Reload the page to see whether it was recorded.
recargar.revisarBitacora: {error} Check the account’s audit log before trying again.

descripciones.ADMIN: Everything: issues, configures the company, series, certificate and API keys, and manages the team.
descripciones.EMISOR: Issues, views and voids receipts, and saves customers and products. Cannot change the settings or the team.
descripciones.LECTURA: View only: receipts, company, series, plan and usage. Cannot issue or configure anything.

sinPermiso.emitir: Your role (Read-only) only allows viewing: ask an account administrator for whatever you need changed.
sinPermiso.configurar: Only an account administrator can change the settings.
sinPermiso.pagina: This section is only for account administrators. Ask one for whatever you need.

equipo.descripcion: The people who sign in to your account’s portal and what each one can do. Invite by email: the link lasts 7 days and works only once.

sinSpec.texto: The interactive reference is generated from the API, which is not available right now. Meanwhile you can read the [integration guide](/developers/guia), the [SUNAT catalogs](/developers/catalogos) and the [error codes](/developers/errores).

referencia.intro: The `/v1` endpoints with their fields and responses. Issuing and query endpoints authenticate with an API key in the `X-Api-Key` header; the one you generate here is filled in automatically in the reference’s authentication field.

generarKey.cargada: It is already filled in the authentication field below. Save it now: it will not be shown in full again.
generarKey.intro: Try the endpoints below with a real API key from your account.

catalogos.noDisponible: We could not load the catalogs: they are served by the API, which is not available right now. Try again in a moment; the rest of the documentation does not depend on them.
catalogos.intro: Official codes expected by the API fields (Annex 8 of SUNAT’s validation rules, version 2026-08-26). The same data is available through the API, without credentials: `GET /v1/catalogos/{id}`.

uso.01: Document type (`tipo` in responses) and `guias[].tipo` (only `09` and `31`).
uso.03: `items[].unidad`. The full UN/ECE rec 20, with the most used units first (column “Más usada”); a code outside the catalog responds `422` (2936) before using up a number.
uso.05: Taxes khipu writes in the XML according to each item’s tax treatment; not sent through the API.
uso.06: `cliente.tipo_doc`. In a domestic sale invoice, `6` (RUC); in exports, the foreign customer’s document. In a receipt any of them, or `-` with no document: only in soles and up to S/ 700.00.
uso.07: `items[].tipo_afectacion_igv`. Paid 10/20/30; free 11–16, 21, 31–37 (price = reference value, not charged). 17 IVAP (milled rice, 4 % instead of IGV; the whole document); 40 export (no IGV, only with operation type 0200–0208). Extra column: tax code it generates.
uso.09: `motivo` of a credit note (`POST /v1/notas` with `tipo: 07`); `13` reschedules installments with a 0 amount.
uso.12: `documentos_relacionados[].tipo` (`04`–`09`, `99`; a receipt does not accept `06` or `07`); khipu writes `02` for advance payment invoices (`anticipos`).
uso.16: Line price type: `01` sale price, `02` reference value for free items. Assigned by khipu.
uso.25: `items[].codigo_sunat` (8-digit UNSPSC). Only lists 25.1 (mandatory register), 25.2 (detracciones) and 25.3 (perceptions); the API accepts any 8-digit code and SUNAT flags those not in its full catalog.
uso.51: `tipo_operacion`. Extra column: documents it applies to; a code outside the catalog, or one khipu does not issue yet for that document, responds `422` (the list is in the issuing guide).
uso.52: Legends khipu adds to the XML (amount in words 1000, free items 1002, detracción 2006…). Not sent through the API.
uso.53: Assigned by khipu: discounts 00–03 and charges 46–50 according to `afecta_base_igv` and `motivo` (46 = `recargo_consumo`), withholding 62, perception 51–53 and advance payments 04–06; the response returns the derived `codigo`. Extra column: level (line or global).

entornos.resumen: How BETA and production differ, what caps the API has and how long to wait before trying again. Everything on this page is what khipu does today; the outbound IPs, the SLA and the connectors are at the end.
entornos.intro: Each company has its environment, set when it is registered. The API URL and the API key are the same in both: what changes is where khipu sends the document and what validity it has. The move from BETA to production is done by the platform, on request to support, once SUNAT has approved the certification: there is no control to do it in the portal or the API, and it is rejected (409) while the company has pending submissions.
entornos.notaBeta: Integrate and test everything in `BETA`: what SUNAT accepts there it accepts in production under the same content rules. The cases khipu verified against e-beta are in the [issuing guide](/developers/guia).

entornos.emisionSimultanea: Issuing has no requests-per-second cap: what bounds it is the plan’s monthly cap. Simultaneous issues on **the same series** are handled one after another, because SUNAT requires consecutive numbering with no gaps; spreading the load across several series parallelizes them.
entornos.pendienteIntro: What khipu offers today in infrastructure, during the beta, so that you do not assume more than there is:
pendientes: **Outbound IPs.** khipu does not guarantee a list of outbound IPs to your server and does not commit to keeping the ones it uses today. Do not filter webhooks by IP; verify each delivery with the `X-Khipu-Signature` signature, which does not depend on the IP: see [Webhooks](/developers/guia#webhooks).

**SLA.** During the beta there is no commitment on availability or response time. What is measured is the cost of preparing a document without SUNAT (around 30 ms at the 95th percentile with 50 documents per second in the load test, measured in development: it is not a commitment); the total time depends on SUNAT.
Official **SDKs and connectors**: they do not exist yet. The API is REST with JSON and the snippets in the [quick start guide](/developers/guia#inicio-rapido) are the starting point.

The same, plus the cross-check with the register.

429 LIMITE_PLAN; 402 PLAN_VENCIDO when the plan expired and its grace days have passed.
From 1 to 100 results per page (20 by default); the total comes in the X-Total-Count header.
The documents listing clamps the value to the range; the customers, products and webhook deliveries listings respond 422 PAGINACION_INVALIDA.

reintentos: Idempotency-Key
24 hours: repeating the same key with the same request returns 200 with the same document; with different content it responds 422 IDEMPOTENCIA_INVALIDA.
Resending a document in ERROR_ENVIO
khipu retries on its own with increasing waits, up to 20 attempts (about 74 hours). A receipt is not abandoned while it is still within the daily summary deadline (up to the 7th day).
Checking the ticket of a voiding or a daily summary
Every 30 seconds at first, with an increasing interval up to 5 minutes, with no limit on attempts while SUNAT does not respond.
Webhook delivery

If your server does not respond 2xx, khipu retries at 1, 5 and 15 minutes and at 1, 3, 6 and 12 hours. That is 8 attempts in total (about 22 hours); after 10 failures in a row the webhook is turned off and the account is notified by email.
Webhook delivery log
30 days (GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/entregas).
Deadline to send to SUNAT

Invoice and its notes: 3 calendar days from issue. Receipt and its notes: on its own up to the 5th day and through the daily summary up to the 7th; after the 7th it is reported late. Receipt credit note 10 and debit note 03 do not go in the summary: they expire on the 5th and end up in FUERA_DE_PLAZO.
Voiding (baja)
Up to 7 calendar days from issue, in Lima time (rule 2957).

RECIBIDO: Data validated and number assigned; the XML is not signed yet.
FIRMADO: XML signed and validated against SUNAT’s schemas; not sent.

Only persists with enviar_automatico: false. Send it with POST /v1/facturas/{id}/enviar before fecha_limite_envio: invoice and its notes, 3 days; receipt and receipt note, like the receipt, on its own up to the 5th day and through the daily summary up to the 7th (receipt credit note 10 and debit note 03 do not go in the summary: up to the 5th). After the 7th day a receipt does not expire: it is reported in a late daily summary; SUNAT may flag it with 4443 (ACEPTADO_CON_OBS), and in e-beta it accepted it with no observations.
ENVIADO: SUNAT received the document and there is no final answer yet.
Check later; khipu updates it when the CDR arrives.
ACEPTADO: SUNAT accepted it (CDR with code 0). Valid document.
Download the CDR (enlaces.cdr) and deliver the document to your customer.
ACEPTADO_CON_OBS: Accepted with observations (codes 4xxx). It is valid.

Read cdr.observaciones and fix the cause in later issues: SUNAT turns observations into rejections over time. A receipt sent after the 7th day may end up like this with 4443 (reported late; baja.fuera_de_plazo: true): send receipts on time.
RECHAZADO: SUNAT rejected it (2000–3999) or an issuer error prevented receiving it (1000–1999).

Final. Fix what cdr.descripcion says and issue a new document, with another number: the rejected one keeps its own (on a 2000–3999 rejection SUNAT considers it used) and khipu never reassigns a number; a repeated sequence number responds 409 DUPLICADO.
ERROR_ENVIO: SUNAT was not available or communication failed.
It is not a rejection. khipu retries on its own with increasing waits (up to 20 attempts); you can force it with POST /v1/facturas/{id}/enviar.
INVALIDO: The XML did not pass local (schema) validation.
Contact support with the id: it should not happen with data the API accepted.
ANULADO: Voiding accepted by SUNAT: in a voiding communication (invoice and its notes) or in the daily summary (receipt and its notes).
Final: the number is used up.
FUERA_DE_PLAZO: It did not reach SUNAT within the sending deadline and has no channel left (fecha_limite_envio, calendar days from issue: 3 for invoice and its notes —2108—; 5 for receipt credit note 10 and debit note 03, which do not go in the daily summary —1079—). It is marked when trying to send it or in the hourly sweep. A receipt, or a receipt note that goes in the summary, no longer reaches this status: after the 7th day it is reported in a late daily summary: SUNAT does not reject it and may flag it with 4443.

Final; the number is used up: issue a new document with a current date. A manual send responds 409 FUERA_DE_PLAZO. A receipt that was already in this status before the change is not reopened: contact support.
DESCARTADO: khipu support stopped trying to send it: it was in ERROR_ENVIO and was not recovering.
Final: issue a new document; the number is used up. A manual send responds 409 ESTADO_NO_ENVIABLE.

http.200: Success. 201 on create (invoice, note, series, API key); 200 when repeating an issue request with the same Idempotency-Key (the document already issued); 204 with no body (certificate, credentials, revoke).
http.400: Malformed request: invalid JSON (JSON_INVALIDO) or a parameter with the wrong format (PARAMETRO_INVALIDO).
http.401: No valid credentials: the X-Api-Key is missing or invalid (NO_AUTORIZADO), or the portal session expired.
http.403: Operation reserved for the portal (REQUIERE_SESION: API key management), a company of another account (EMPRESA_AJENA) or, with a portal session, a role that does not allow it (ROL_INSUFICIENTE). With X-Api-Key there are no roles.
http.404: Does not exist or belongs to another company (NO_ENCONTRADO); proof not available yet (SIN_CDR); route does not exist (RUTA_INEXISTENTE).
http.409: Conflict: repeated sequence number (DUPLICADO), document that cannot be sent (ESTADO_NO_ENVIABLE), past the sending deadline (FUERA_DE_PLAZO), not accepted yet for sending by email (NO_ACEPTADO) or branch with active series (ESTABLECIMIENTO_EN_USO).
http.422: Data valid in form but not in substance: field validation (VALIDACION, details in errores) or a business rule (codigo says which).
http.500: Internal error; the message includes a trace_id for support.
http.502: Outgoing email failure when sending a document: the mail server rejected it (502 CORREO_NO_ENVIADO) or it is not enabled (503 CORREO_NO_CONFIGURADO).

VALIDACION: One or more fields do not meet format or required rules; errores lists field → messages.
SERIE_INVALIDA: The series does not have its type’s format: invoice (01) F + 3 alphanumeric characters; receipt (03) B + 3; note (07/08) F or B + 3 (FC01, BC01). When registering it in POST /v1/series, the type does not match the letter. In a note, the series does not start with the letter of the document it modifies (F on an invoice, B on a receipt: 2399/2400).
Use F### for invoices and their notes, B### for receipts and their notes, registered with their type.
SERIE_NO_CONFIGURADA: The series is not registered in the company.
Create it with POST /v1/series or in the portal.
DUPLICADO: A document with that series and sequence number already exists (or the series already exists).
Safe retry: nothing new was issued.
IDEMPOTENCIA_INVALIDA: The Idempotency-Key of POST /v1/facturas or POST /v1/notas was already used with different content in the last 24 hours, or it does not have the format (8 to 100 letters, digits, - or _). Invoice and note keys are independent.
Use a new key (a UUID) per invoice or note; repeat the same key only to retry the same request, which responds 200 with the same document.
NUMERO_YA_ASIGNADO: Tried to assign a number to a document that already has one.
Should not happen through the API; contact support.
FECHA_INVALIDA: fecha_emision in the future, with the sending deadline already past (invoice and its notes: more than 3 calendar days back, 2108; receipt and its notes: more than 7, 1079; receipt credit note 10 and debit note 03: more than 5, 1079), or fecha_vencimiento before the issue date. Only when issuing: a receipt already issued that is sent after the 7th day does not give this error, it is reported late (4443).

Use an issue date of today or of the previous days within the deadline (3 for invoice and its notes, 7 for receipt and its notes, 5 for receipt credit note 10 and debit note 03) and a due date equal to or later.
MONEDA_INVALIDA: Catalog 02 currency that khipu does not issue (3088): PEN, USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, CHF, JPY, CNY, MXN, BRL, CLP, COP, ARS, BOB, UYU and PYG are accepted.
Use one of those currencies in uppercase.
TIPO_CAMBIO_INVALIDO: tipo_cambio in a PEN document, or not positive, or with more than 3 integer digits or 3 decimals.
Send soles per unit of the currency (for example 3.756) only when the currency is not PEN.
TIPO_OPERACION_INVALIDO: tipo_operacion does not exist in catalog 51 or does not apply to the document type (rule 3206); in a receipt, khipu only issues 0101, 0113 (NRUS), 0200/0201/0203/0204/0206/0207/0208 (export), 0401, 1001–1004 (detracción) and 2001 (perception); in an invoice, 0101, 0200/0201/0203/0204/0206/0207/0208 (export), 0401, 1001–1004 and 2001. The others (0112, 0301, 0302, 2002, 2100–2104, 2106) are not issued yet, and 0202/0205 (lodging and tour package for non-residents) require the guest’s data per line and are not issued either.

Use one of the types khipu issues for that document (the ones above); being in catalog 51 with “Factura” or “Boleta” is not enough. Export and 0401 go in an invoice or a receipt (in a receipt with a buyer without RUC: RECEPTOR_INVALIDO, 2800).
RECEPTOR_INVALIDO: The buyer does not meet the rules of its document. Domestic sale invoice: tipo_doc 6 and a valid RUC (11 digits starting with 10/15/16/17/20 and a correct check digit, 2017). Export (0200–0208): a catalog 06 document with its format (2800–2802), `pais` required (ISO 3166-1) and no RUC in 0200/0201/0204 (2800). Receipt: any catalog 06 document —8-digit DNI (4207), RUC with check digit (2017), the others up to 15 characters without spaces (4208)— or tipo_doc and num_doc “-” with no document, in PEN or in another currency with `tipo_cambio`, and with a total amount (in soles) of up to S/ 700.00; in an export receipt (0200–0208) or one to non-residents (0401) the buyer has no RUC (2800). A note follows the rule of the document it modifies (it takes its buyer). In all of them, business name or name of 3 to 1500 characters not counting leading and trailing spaces and without line breaks (2022; in a receipt, an error at SUNAT from 2027-01-01). A RUC that is not in SUNAT’s register (1083, in invoices, receipts with RUC and notes), while the register is up to date: SUNAT would reject the document. A deregistered RUC (4013) or one not located (4014) is not an error: it is issued and the response carries `avisos`. Also a `cliente.email` that is not an email address or exceeds 150 characters.

Fix cliente.tipo_doc / num_doc / razon_social / email. With no document, use “CLIENTES VARIOS” as the name; above S/ 700 or in another currency, identify the buyer. With 1083, confirm the RUC at SUNAT; if it belongs to a newly registered company, retry the next day, when the register includes it. It is detected before using up a number.
RUC_INVALIDO: The company’s RUC does not have 11 digits with prefix 10/15/16/17/20 or its check digit does not match.
Copy the RUC exactly as it appears in the RUC record.
SIN_ITEMS: Document with no items. It is not seen through the API: in invoices and receipts an empty items responds VALIDACION, and a note without items is a full note (it copies the document’s items).
FORMA_PAGO_INVALIDA: Payment method rule not met; the message starts with the SUNAT code (3244–3267, 3319). A receipt on credit: the receipt is issued as cash.
Adjust installments, pending amount or dates as the message says; a credit sale goes in an invoice.
DESCUENTO_INVALIDO: SUNAT rule on discounts, charges, detracción, withholding or perception not met; the message starts with the SUNAT code (e.g. 2954, 3127, 3263, 3308). RETENCION_INVALIDA also rejects a withholding in a receipt (it is applied by an agent with RUC: it goes in an invoice). It includes the sector data of the detracción: 1002 requires `hidrobiologico` on each item (3063, 3130–3135) and 1004 `transporte` (3116–3126); outside those operations they are not accepted.
Fix the data indicated; see the corresponding case in the guide (detracción, hydrobiological products, freight transport).
ITEM_INVALIDO: Item without a description or with more than 500 characters (2026/2027), unit of measure that does not exist in catalog 03 (2936; blank responds VALIDACION), quantity zero or with more than 12 integer digits / 10 decimals (2024/2025), negative or zero price (2369; the reference value of a free item, 2367) or a line whose sale value ends up at 0.00 (2370), ICBPER bags with a non-integer quantity or of more than 5 digits (2892) or with a unit other than NIU in a new document (SUNAT only flags 4320; khipu rejects it because ICBPER is per bag), ICBPER in an NRUS receipt (operation type 0113, 3240), more than 999 lines (2023; 2137 in notes), internal code of more than 30 characters, SUNAT product code or GTIN with an invalid format (3496, 4334, 4335), or rounding outside ±1.00 (3303).
Fix the field indicated; see the case “Due date, product code, GTIN and rounding” in the guide.
AFECTACION_INVALIDA: Document subject to IVAP (tax treatment 17, milled rice) with items of another treatment (10/20/30 or free), or an IVAP line with ISC or ICBPER (2650, 3223). Export (operation type 0200–0208) with items that are not `40` (2642), item `40` in a domestic sale (3107), or a `40` line with ISC/ICBPER (3223).
Issue the IVAP document only with `17` items and the export only with `40` items, without `isc` or `icbper`; the other sales go in another document.
EXPORTACION_INVALIDA: `exportacion` in a domestic sale; Incoterm outside Incoterms 2020; `pais_uso` missing in 0201/0208 (3098), equal to PE or outside catalog 04 (3099), or present in a type that does not accept it (4041).
Send `exportacion` only with `tipo_operacion` 0200–0208, with a valid Incoterm and `pais_uso` only in 0201/0208.
LEYENDA_INVALIDA: Legend that does not exist in catalog 52 (3027), that khipu generates on its own (1000, 1002, 2000, 2006, 2007), or 2001/2002/2003/2008 in an invoice without an exempt total (3283–3285, 3289).
Send in `leyendas` only zone or regime codes from catalog 52 (`GET /v1/catalogos/52`) and, for the Amazon or Tacna ones, exempt items.
NOMBRE_COMERCIAL_INVALIDO: The company’s trade name exceeds 1500 characters or has line breaks (rule 4092).
Fix it in `PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales` or on the Company page.
NOTA_INVALIDA: The modified invoice or receipt does not exist, is not accepted or is voided (2119/2120); the note’s date is before the document’s (2885); the reason is not in catalog 09/10 (2172); credit note 13 on a receipt (3259); credit note 04, 05 or 08 on a receipt (4367: a discount or bonus to an end consumer goes in the same receipt, RCP art. 10 num. 1.4); in a credit note on a receipt the total allows S/ 1 extra; the credit note exceeds the invoice amounts, or the balance left after previous credit notes (3286/3503 — SUNAT compares note by note; khipu also accumulates, so two full notes do not credit the same invoice twice); credit note 13 on a cash invoice or one without installments (3257/3260/3320/3321); full note (without items) on an invoice with advance payments, or with its own descuento_global/cargos; forma_pago outside credit note 13.
Issue the note on an ACEPTADA invoice with a reason from the catalog; in partial notes check quantities and amounts; on invoices with advance payments send items for the net amount.
BAJA_INVALIDA: The document is not accepted by SUNAT (2398; in a receipt and its notes, 2663), more than 7 calendar days have passed since its issue, in Lima time (2957; not counted from SUNAT’s acceptance), the reason does not have 3–100 characters (2315) or there is already a voiding in progress.
Void only ACEPTADO documents within the deadline; outside it issue a credit note. A receipt reported late is already past the 7 days: it is not voided, it is corrected with a credit note.
DOCUMENTO_RELACIONADO_INVALIDO: Purchase order, dispatch guide or other related document with an invalid or repeated format (rules 4233, 4005, 4006, 4009, 4010, 2364, 2365). In a receipt, a related document of type 06 or 07 (4009: the receipt only accepts 04, 05, 08, 09 and 99).

Check the number (series-number for a guide, no spaces in other documents) and the catalog type; advance payment invoices go in `anticipos`. Remove the 06 or 07 document from the receipt (an invoice does accept them).
OTROS_TRIBUTOS_INVALIDO: The `otros_tributos` rate is not a positive percentage of up to 3 integer digits and 5 decimals (3102); or they are combined with a global discount (02) or a global charge (49) that affects the base, which is not supported yet. In free items and in exports it responds AFECTACION_INVALIDA (3223, 3107).
Send a rate between 0.00001 and 999.99999 and remove the global discount or charge, or move it to the lines.
ANTICIPO_INVALIDO: The advance payment invoice (series F) or receipt (series B) does not exist in the company, is not accepted by SUNAT (3218), belongs to another customer or currency (2071), is repeated (3215) or the amount exceeds what was invoiced.
Issue the advance payment invoice or receipt and wait for its acceptance; use its series-number and the value without IGV.
FUERA_DE_PLAZO: Asked to send a document whose deadline expired with no channel to reach SUNAT: an invoice or invoice note after the 3rd day (2108), a receipt credit note 10 or debit note 03 after the 5th (1079). The document stays in the FUERA_DE_PLAZO status. A receipt, or a receipt note that goes in the daily summary, never: after the 5th day it is reported in a daily summary (up to the 7th on time, then late, which SUNAT may flag with 4443).
Issue a new document with a current date; the expired one’s number is used up.
CDR_YA_DISPONIBLE: Asked to recover from SUNAT the CDR of a document that already has it.
CDR_NO_CONSULTABLE: Asked to recover the CDR of a receipt or a receipt note (series B) with POST /v1/facturas/{id}/cdr/recuperar. According to SUNAT’s programmer manual, getStatusCdr only covers invoices and credit and debit notes (01, 07, 08) of series F; the receipt and its notes are left out. The hourly recovery sweep does not query them either. What SUNAT would answer to that query is not documented, and in e-beta it cannot be checked because the query service is not published there.

Its proof is the one from the individual submission or from the daily summary that reported it: if it was reported in a summary, see it in GET /v1/facturas/{id}/bajas and check its ticket with GET /v1/bajas/{id}; if it was sent on its own and ended up in ERROR_ENVIO, retry the submission with POST /v1/facturas/{id}/enviar. If it already has its CDR, download it with GET /v1/facturas/{id}/cdr (CDR_YA_DISPONIBLE).
NO_DISPONIBLE_EN_BETA: CDR or validity query with a company in the BETA environment: SUNAT does not publish billConsultService or billValidService in e-beta.
For validity, load the company’s SUNAT API credentials (PUT /v1/empresa/credenciales-api-sunat): SUNAT’s REST API does work in beta. For the CDR, use a company in PRODUCCION.
CREDENCIALES_SUNAT_NO_CARGADAS: A document’s validity was queried and the company has neither SUNAT API credentials nor a SOL password.
Load the SUNAT API credentials (client_id and client_secret from “Credenciales de API SUNAT” in SOL) or the SOL credentials.
CREDENCIALES_API_SUNAT_INVALIDAS: When saving the SUNAT API credentials, the client_id has spaces or other characters that do not belong in an identifier, or does not start with a letter or digit. If either of the two is missing, it responds 422 VALIDACION.
Copy the “Id” and the “Clave” exactly as SOL shows them.
CREDENCIALES_API_SUNAT_RECHAZADAS: SUNAT did not accept the client_id/client_secret (or the application is not allowed to query) and the company has no SOL password to query another way.
Check the application in SOL (“Credenciales de API SUNAT”), generate a new secret if needed and save them again.
CONSULTA_RECHAZADA: SUNAT rejected the data of the validity query (series format, number, date or amount). It is not retried through another channel: the answer would be the same.
Fix the data indicated in the message.
SUNAT_NO_DISPONIBLE: Neither SUNAT’s REST API nor billValidService answered the validity query (timeout, 5xx error).
Retry later; the query does not change anything.
RVIE_SIN_TIPO_CAMBIO: Sales register (GET /v1/sire/rvie): there are documents of the period in another currency without an exchange rate, which field 28 of the RVIE requires. The message names the first ones.
Request it with permitir_sin_tipo_cambio=true (the field comes out empty and the count goes in X-Rvie-Sin-Tipo-Cambio) and fill in the exchange rate in the file before uploading it to SIRE.
RVIE_EXCEDE_EL_TOPE: The period has more than 100,000 documents, or the proposal sent for reconciliation more than 100,000 rows.
Ask support for the file or the reconciliation.
RVIE_ARCHIVO_INVALIDO: The proposal sent to POST /v1/sire/rvie/conciliacion cannot be read: empty or without data rows, a row with a field out of format, from another RUC or another period, a repeated document, a line of more than 16 KB, or a damaged ZIP or one without a .txt. The message gives the line and the field.
Send the proposal exactly as you downloaded it from SIRE, for the same period and the same company.
RVIE_PROPUESTA_DEMASIADO_GRANDE: The proposal sent for reconciliation weighs more than 20 MB, or its text more than 64 MB uncompressed.
Send it compressed as .zip; if it still does not fit, ask support for the reconciliation.
ESTABLECIMIENTO_INVALIDO: Branch code that is not 4 digits (3030), `0000` sent as an annex (it is the tax address), annex that does not exist or was deregistered when creating a series or issuing, or route code different from the body.
Register the annex in `POST /v1/empresa/establecimientos` with the code from the RUC record and assign it to the series; 0000 is edited in the tax data.
ESTABLECIMIENTO_EN_USO: Tried to deregister a branch that still has active series.
Create the replacement series in another branch before deregistering it.
DOMICILIO_INVALIDO: Company tax data out of format: ubigeo not in catalog 13 (4093), address with line breaks or outside 3–200 characters (4094), annex branch that is not 4 digits (3030), Banco de la Nación account with invalid characters.
Fix it in PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales or on the portal’s Company page.
CREDENCIALES_SOL_NO_CARGADAS: The company has no SOL user/password and sending to SUNAT was requested.
Load them in the portal or issue with enviar_automatico: false.
CERTIFICADO_NO_CARGADO: No certificate, expired, or its OU does not contain the RUC.
Load a valid certificate of the company.
LIMITE_PLAN: The account reached its plan’s monthly document cap (invoices, receipts and notes of all its companies). Nothing is issued and no number is used.
Issue again next month or ask for a plan change; the voiding communication does not count.
CUPO_DEL_PLAN: The account’s plan no longer allows one more active API key, user (pending invitations count) or company. The message says how much the plan includes and how much the account has; whatever already exceeded the cap is left alone.
Revoke an API key, deactivate a user or revoke an invitation to free a spot, or ask for a plan change.
PLAN_VENCIDO: The account’s plan expired and its grace days have passed (during grace, issuing continues). It applies to invoices, receipts and notes; nothing is issued and no number is used.
Renew the plan to issue again; querying what was already issued and the voiding communication keep working.
XSD_INVALIDO: The generated XML did not validate or could not be signed.
Contact support with the id; it is usually a value outside a catalog.
NO_ACEPTADO: Asked to send by email a document that SUNAT has not accepted yet (FIRMADO, ERROR_ENVIO, RECHAZADO or ANULADO).
Wait for acceptance; the PDF can be downloaded from FIRMADO.
CORREO_NO_ENVIADO: The mail server rejected or did not accept the delivery to the buyer (SMTP down, invalid mailbox).
Retry later; the document does not change status.
CORREO_NO_CONFIGURADO: The server does not have email sending enabled: nothing was sent to the buyer, or automatic sending to the customer cannot be turned on (PUT /v1/empresa/envio-al-cliente).
Retrying does not help until it is enabled; deliver the PDF yourself or contact support.
PERSONALIZACION_INVALIDA: PDF design out of format (unknown template, non-hexadecimal color, footer of more than 300 characters or with line breaks, observations of more than 1000), logo that is not PNG/JPEG or weighs more than 200 KB, or document observations with control characters.
Fix the value indicated in the message; the PDF texts do not affect the XML or SUNAT.
EXPORTACION_EXCEDE_EL_TOPE: An export (GET /v1/facturas/exportacion) allows up to 5000 documents and the filters return more; the message says how many there are.
Narrow the dates and export in batches.
SIN_FIRMA: The PDF was requested for a document that is not numbered and signed yet.
Only happens with INVALIDO documents; fix and issue again.
ESTADO_NO_ENVIABLE: Tried to send an ACEPTADO, RECHAZADO or ANULADO document.
Only FIRMADO and ERROR_ENVIO are sent.
ENVIO_EN_CURSO: Another submission of the same document (another call or the automatic retry) is waiting for SUNAT's answer.
It is not sent twice: query the document again in a few seconds.
SUNAT_YA_LO_TIENE: SUNAT answered that it already has the document (an earlier submission arrived without a response) and its receipt cannot be recovered automatically.
It stays in ERROR_ENVIO with no automatic retry: check the CDR in SOL and, if it is accepted, do not issue it again.
ESTADO_CONFLICTO: Two operations changed the status at the same time.
SIN_CDR: SUNAT has not issued the proof yet.
CDR_CORRUPTO: The stored proof cannot be read.
NO_ENCONTRADO: The resource does not exist or belongs to another company.
NO_AUTORIZADO: Generate a new key in the portal.
REQUIERE_SESION: Creating, listing or revoking API keys only from the portal.
Do it from the portal with your session.
ROL_INSUFICIENTE: Only with a portal session: the user’s role does not allow the operation. LECTURA only queries; EMISOR issues, sends, voids and shares documents and saves customers and products, but does not change companies, series, certificate, SOL credentials, branches, API keys, webhooks or the team; ADMIN can do everything. A request with X-Api-Key does not depend on roles: the key belongs to the company and only an ADMIN creates it. In the portal, what the role does not allow appears disabled with the reason (not hidden); the API keys and Team sections are only shown to administrators.
Ask an administrator of the account to perform the operation, or to change your role.
DEMASIADAS_INVITACIONES: Only with a portal session, when inviting or resending an invitation: the account has 20 pending invitations, or in the last 24 hours it already sent 30 invitation emails, or that address already received 3 (from any account). Inviting and resending count, including invitations that were later revoked.
Revoke the pending ones you do not need or try again the next day.
PARAMETRO_INVALIDO: A route or query parameter does not have the expected format (e.g. an id that is not a UUID, the CDR format).
JSON_INVALIDO: The body is not valid JSON.
Check quotes, commas and UTF-8 encoding.
RUTA_INEXISTENTE: The route does not exist in this API version.
Check the path and the version.
INTERNO: Retry; if it persists, send the trace_id to support.

errores.resumen: What each document status, each HTTP code and each API error code means, and what to do in each case. When the rule comes from SUNAT, the message carries its official code.
errores.ciclo: The normal cycle is `RECIBIDO` → `FIRMADO` → `ENVIADO` → `ACEPTADO`. The other statuses are detours with a specific action:
errores.notaErrorEnvio: `ERROR_ENVIO` does not mean SUNAT rejected anything: the document already has a number and a signature, and khipu will deliver it. Only `RECHAZADO` requires fixing and issuing again.
errores.codigosIntro: They go in the response envelope’s `codigo` and are stable: code against them, not against the text of `mensaje`.
errores.sunatIntro: SUNAT responds with a numeric code that khipu keeps in `cdr.codigo` (SUNAT’s response) or at the start of `mensaje` (when khipu applies the same rule before sending). The ranges:
sunatFilas: SUNAT service or authentication failure (0100 system not available, 0102 wrong SOL user or password, 0111 no profile to issue).
khipu retries on its own (ERROR_ENVIO). If it is a 010x credentials code, fix the SOL user/password in the portal.
Issuer error in the submission: file name, empty XML, document already registered with other data (1033), issuer not authorized (1078).
The document stays RECHAZADO with no retries; check the message and issue again.
Rejection due to content validation (amounts, catalogs, payment method, buyer…).
RECHAZADO: the number is used up. Fix the data indicated and issue a new document, with another number.
Observation: accepted, but some data should be fixed. For example 4443, which SUNAT may give to a receipt reported in the daily summary after the 7th day (in e-beta it did not).
ACEPTADO_CON_OBS: valid; fix it in future issues (for 4443, send receipts on time).
errores.sunatEjemplos: Examples of rules khipu checks locally with the same code: `3244` payment method missing, `3249` credit without installments, `3319` installments do not add up to the pending amount, `3267` installment due before the issue date. SUNAT publishes the full table of return codes in its validation rules; the code catalogs are in [SUNAT catalogs](/developers/catalogos).

gravada-contado.cuando: Sale of goods or services with IGV, paid at issue. It is the most common invoice.
notas: `precio_unitario` is the price **with IGV**: khipu calculates the unit value (1 000.00), the IGV (18 %, or 10.5 % if the company is in the Special Rate Register for restaurants and hotels — enabled in `PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales`) and the totals; `totales.tasa_igv` shows the rate applied. Do not send amounts without IGV.
`correlativo` omitted: khipu assigns the next number of series F001 atomically (no gaps or duplicates even if you issue in parallel).
`tipo_operacion` omitted = `0101` (domestic sale). `forma_pago` omitted = cash.
Units: `ZZ` for services, `NIU` for countable goods; others in catalog 03.

Line rules rejected before numbering (`422 ITEM_INVALIDO`, the message starts with the SUNAT code): `precio_unitario` greater than zero (2369; in a free item, its reference value, 2367) and a line whose sale value does not end up at `0.00` (2370); up to **999 lines** per document (2023; `2137` in notes), because the item’s line number has up to 3 digits. The same in invoices, receipts and notes.
Response `201` with `estado_documento` `ACEPTADO` if SUNAT answered in the same call.

Buyer’s RUC, against SUNAT’s register (the same in invoices, receipts with RUC and notes): if the RUC **is not listed**, `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO` (1083) before numbering, because SUNAT would reject the document; a newly registered RUC may take a day to be listed. If it is listed but **deregistered** (4013) or **not located** (4014), SUNAT accepts the document with an observation: khipu issues it anyway and the response carries `avisos` (`codigo` and `mensaje`; the field is absent when there is nothing to warn about). If the register is not loaded or is more than 3 days old, nothing is rejected.

mixta.titulo: Taxable, exempt and non-taxable items in the same invoice
mixta.cuando: A sale that combines products with IGV, exempt by law (Appendix I: e.g. books, certain foods) and non-taxable (outside the scope of IGV).
notas: For `20` and `30` the `precio_unitario` **does not include IGV** (there is none): value = price.
khipu groups the totals by tax treatment (`totales.gravado`, `exonerado`, `inafecto`) and builds a `TaxSubtotal` for each tax (IGV 1000, EXO 9997, INA 9998) as SUNAT requires.

Use `20` only if the good or service is in Appendix I of the IGV Law; `30` for operations outside its scope (e.g. sale of land, fees). Using the wrong code is not detected locally but it is a tax contingency.

dolares.cuando: Operations agreed in a foreign currency. All the document’s amounts are in that currency.
notas: Accepted currencies (catalog 02, ISO 4217): `PEN`, `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `CAD`, `AUD`, `CHF`, `JPY`, `CNY`, `MXN`, `BRL`, `CLP`, `COP`, `ARS`, `BOB`, `UYU` and `PYG`; another one responds `422 MONEDA_INVALIDA` (3088) without using up a number. Currencies are not mixed in a document (SUNAT 2071).
The amount in words in the XML is generated in the given currency ("… CON 00/100 DÓLARES AMERICANOS").

`tipo_cambio` (optional, only outside `PEN`): soles per unit of the currency, with up to 3 integer digits and 3 decimals. SUNAT does not receive it in the XML: khipu stores it with the document for the sales register (SIRE) and the PDF, which shows the equivalent in soles. The response carries `tipo_cambio` and `total_en_soles` (443.21 in the example); a note inherits its document’s. In `PEN` it responds `422 TIPO_CAMBIO_INVALIDO`.
With `tipo_cambio`, a receipt in a foreign currency can be issued without the buyer’s document if its total in soles is up to S/ 700.00; without it the document is still required.

credito.cuando: The customer pays after issue, in one or several installments. Declaring it has been mandatory since 2022 (RS 193-2020); it enables factoring of the invoice.
notas: `monto_pendiente` is what is left to pay at issue (it can be less than the total if there was a down payment) and **must equal the sum of the installments** (SUNAT 3319).
Each installment is due **after** the issue date (3267). khipu numbers the installments `Cuota001`, `Cuota002`… in the order sent.
If you send `"tipo": "contado"` with installments or `monto_pendiente`, the API responds `422 FORMA_PAGO_INVALIDA` with `3252 - …`.
The response returns `forma_pago` with SUNAT’s identifiers for each installment.

calcular.cuando: You want to show the user the exact amounts before issuing (discounts, charges, ISC, advance payments, rounding…) without reimplementing the calculation in your system.
notas: It takes **the same body as `POST /v1/facturas`** (invoice or receipt, depending on the series) and responds `200` with the same object as issuing: `items` and `totales` with what khipu would calculate. **It does not number, sign, store or send anything** and does not use up the plan’s quota.

It builds the document with the same domain rules as issuing: whatever issuing would reject by a rule (`ITEM_INVALIDO`, `DESCUENTO_INVALIDO`, `MONEDA_INVALIDA`…) responds here with the same `422` with its `codigo` and `mensaje`.
It does not check what depends on stored data: that the advance payment invoice exists and is accepted, the RUC register, the plan, the series or the certificate. Issuing validates that.
The response’s `id` does not exist, `numero` is `null` and it has no `enlaces`: it is only for showing amounts.

sin-enviar.titulo: Issue without sending and send later
sin-enviar.cuando: Batch issuing outside business hours, or when you want to review the signed XML before it reaches SUNAT.
notas: The document stays `FIRMADO` with its number assigned and its XML downloadable (`GET /v1/facturas/{id}/xml`).

Remember the deadline (`fecha_limite_envio` in the response): an invoice must reach SUNAT within the **3 calendar days** after `fecha_emision`; a receipt goes on its own up to the **5th day** and after that khipu reports it in a daily summary (see “Receipt sent after the 5th day”).
`POST /v1/facturas/{id}/enviar` also works to retry an `ERROR_ENVIO` without waiting for the automatic retry.

correlativo.cuando: Your system already keeps the numbering and you want khipu to respect it, or you need to retry a call without the risk of issuing twice.
notas: If `F001-125` already exists the API responds `409 DUPLICADO` and issues nothing: you can safely retry the same call after a timeout.
Without `correlativo`, khipu uses the next number of the series; do not mix both modes in the same series or you will leave gaps.

idempotency-key.titulo: Safe retry with Idempotency-Key (invoices, receipts and notes)
idempotency-key.cuando: Your call may be cut off after khipu issued (timeout, network down) and you need to repeat it without the risk of issuing twice, even if khipu numbers the series for you. It works the same in `POST /v1/facturas` (invoice and receipt) and in `POST /v1/notas` (credit or debit note, on an invoice or a receipt); below, a note.
notas: Generate **one key per document** (a UUID, or any text of 8 to 100 letters, digits, `-` or `_`) and store it with your internal document until you have the response. Repeat the call with the same key **and the same body**: if it had already been issued, it responds `200` with the document as it is now (for example `ACEPTADO`), without issuing another. Without the header, each call issues a new document.

The same key with **different content** responds `422 IDEMPOTENCIA_INVALIDA` and issues nothing: for another document, another key. A malformed key responds the same code. Two bodies that differ only in spaces or line breaks are the same request.

The key is valid for your company for **24 hours** and is specific to each endpoint: the same string in `POST /v1/facturas` and in `POST /v1/notas` are different keys. If the call failed with an error (`422`, `429`…) the key is released: fix the body and retry, with the same key or another one.

Khipu answers the retry **before validating**: even if in the meantime the sending deadline (2108/1079) or the certificate expired, or the invoice the note modifies was voided or had a voiding in progress, you get the note already issued. For a receipt’s note it works exactly the same.

When you number yourself (`correlativo`, see the previous case) the retry is already safe thanks to `409 DUPLICADO`; the key is what covers the issues where khipu assigns the number, which is the recommended way.

descuentos.cuando: Promotions or negotiations that lower a line or the total without touching the unit price. Each discount is a percentage or an amount (on the value without IGV) and decides whether it affects the IGV base.
notas: Item `descuento`: `porcentaje` **or** `monto` (never both), on the line’s sale value without IGV. `afecta_base_igv` (default `true`) → code **00**: IGV is calculated on the reduced base; `false` → code **01**: financial discount, IGV does not change and only the amount to pay goes down.
`descuento_global`: same format. `afecta_base_igv: true` → code **02**, applied on the taxable base (requires taxable items); `false` → **03**, subtracted from the amount to pay.

The response returns per item `valor_venta`, `igv` and `descuento.monto`, and in `totales`: `total_valor_venta`, `total_precio_venta`, `total_descuentos` (those that do not affect the base) and `total` (to pay).
In the XML: `cac:AllowanceCharge` with factor, amount and base (rules 3052, 2955, 3290 per line; 3025, 2968, 3016 global) and `AllowanceTotalAmount` in the totals (3300).

cargos.cuando: Items charged on top of the price: freight, packaging, administrative fees, consumption surcharge or tips. Each charge is a percentage or an amount (on the value without IGV) and its catalog 53 code decides whether it pays IGV.
notas: `items[].cargos[]`: same format as `descuento` — `porcentaje` **or** `monto` (never both) on the line’s sale value without IGV. `afecta_base_igv` (default `true`) → code **47**: added to the sale value and pays IGV (taxable freight); `false` → **48**: charged without IGV (expense reimbursement). Not accepted on free lines.

Global `cargos[]`: `afecta_base_igv: true` → **49**, added to the taxable base and to IGV (requires taxable items); `false` → **50**, without IGV; `motivo: "recargo_consumo"` → **46**, consumption surcharge and/or tips, which under Law 25988 never affects the base (does not accept `afecta_base_igv: true`). The percentage applies on the taxable base (49) or on the whole paid base (46/50).

The response returns per item `cargos[]` with `monto`, `afecta_base_igv`, `motivo` and the derived SUNAT `codigo`, and in `totales`: global `cargos[]`, `total_cargos` (those that do not affect the base: 48 + 46/50) and `total` = sale price + `total_cargos` − discounts − advance payments. In the example: sale value 1 550.00, IGV 279.00, charges without IGV 20.00 + 155.00 → total 2 004.00.

In the XML: `cac:AllowanceCharge` with `ChargeIndicator true`, factor, amount and base (rules 3114, 3052, 2955, 3290 per line; 3025, 2968, 3016, 3307 global), the IGV base includes 47/49 (3277, 3291) and `ChargeTotalAmount` in the totals (3301, 3280). FISE (45) is not supported.

documentos-relacionados.titulo: Purchase order, dispatch guides and other documents
documentos-relacionados.cuando: The invoice goes with a shipment with a dispatch guide, answers a customer’s purchase order or supports a procedure (SCOP code, ENAPU ticket, import declaration…). They are informational data: they do not change amounts.
notas: `orden_compra`: 1–20 characters (spaces allowed, no line breaks) → `cac:OrderReference` (rule 4233).

`guias[]`: `tipo` **09** (shipper’s dispatch guide) or **31** (carrier’s), `numero` series-number with the format SUNAT requires: electronic `T001-123` / `V001-45`, paper `0001-123`, `EG01-45`… (rules 4005, 4006); repeated ones are not accepted (2364) → `cac:DespatchDocumentReference`.

`documentos_relacionados[]`: `tipo` from catalog 12 —**04** ENAPU ticket, **05** SCOP code, **06** shipper’s electronic invoice, **07** shipper’s guide, **08** free-zone warehouse exit, **09** simplified import declaration, **99** others— and `numero` of up to 30 characters without spaces (rules 4009, 4010, 2365) → `cac:AdditionalDocumentReference`. Advance payment invoices (02) go in `anticipos`, not here. A **receipt** does not accept **06** or **07**: SUNAT flags them with 4009 (Boleta2_0 only accepts 04, 05, 08, 09 and 99) and khipu rejects them with 422 `DOCUMENTO_RELACIONADO_INVALIDO` before numbering.

The response returns the `referencias { orden_compra, guias[], documentos_relacionados[] }` block only when one of them was sent; the portal’s detail shows it as "Documentos relacionados". Error `DOCUMENTO_RELACIONADO_INVALIDO` (422) with the SUNAT rule in the message.

campos-opcionales.titulo: Due date, product code, GTIN and rounding
campos-opcionales.cuando: Data the customer or SUNAT may expect without changing the calculation: the payment due date, the SUNAT product code (mandatory for issuers in the register: mining, fuels, explosives…), the product’s GTIN and rounding to collect cash without cents.
notas: `fecha_vencimiento` → `cbc:DueDate`; it cannot be before `fecha_emision` (`FECHA_INVALIDA`). It is informational: on credit the `forma_pago` installments still rule.

`items[].codigo_sunat`: 8-digit UNSPSC (catalog 25) → `cac:CommodityClassification`. khipu validates the format (rule 3496); SUNAT flags —does not reject— those not in its list (4332) or not reaching the third level (ending in 0000, 4337). `GET /v1/catalogos/25` returns lists 25.1 (mandatory register), 25.2 (detracciones) and 25.3 (perceptions); SUNAT publishes the full catalog.
`items[].gtin { tipo, codigo }`: `GTIN-8`, `GTIN-12`, `GTIN-13` or `GTIN-14` with the matching length (rules 4333–4335) → `cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID@schemeID`.

`redondeo`: between −1.00 and 1.00, added to the total to pay (`PayableRoundingAmount`, rule 3303; `total` = sale price + charges − discounts − advance payments + rounding, rule 3280); the amount in words uses the rounded total. In the example: 7 × 16.91 = 118.37 → total 118.00. Error `REDONDEO_INVALIDO`.

The issuer’s trade name does not go in each invoice: it is configured once in `PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales` (`nombre_comercial`) or on the portal’s Company page and khipu writes it in `cac:PartyName` (rule 4092).

`observaciones` (up to 1000 characters, line breaks allowed) is printed in the PDF’s «Observaciones» block and does **not** go to the XML or SUNAT. If omitted, the company’s default observations are printed (`PUT /v1/empresa/personalizacion-pdf`), which also sets the PDF’s template, color, logo and footer. Error `OBSERVACIONES_INVALIDAS`.

gratuitas.cuando: You deliver goods or services without charging: volume bonus, samples, advertising, withdrawal for employees. SUNAT requires reporting them with their reference value and, if taxable, with the IGV they would have generated.
notas: Free tax treatments from catalog 07: `11`–`16` (taxable: prize withdrawal, donation, withdrawal, advertising, bonus, delivery to employees), `21` (exempt) and `31`–`37` (non-taxable). On these lines `precio_unitario` is the **reference value without IGV**, not a sale price, and must be greater than zero (`422 ITEM_INVALIDO`, 2367): SUNAT does not accept a free item without a reference value.
