The line does not add to the amount to pay: the response carries `gratuita: true`, `precio_venta: 0.00` and, for taxable ones, the informational `igv`. In `totales`, `gratuito` and `igv_gratuitas` go apart from `total`.

In the XML: `PriceTypeCode 02` (reference value), `Price/PriceAmount 0`, tax `9996` (GRA) per line and in its own global subtotal, and the mandatory legend `1002`. Rules 2640, 3110, 3111, 3224, 3234, 3276, 3302.
An invoice with only free items has `total` 0.00. Free items are not mixed with IVAP (`17`) or with exports (`40`): see their cases.

detraccion.cuando: Services and goods in the detracciones annex (freight transport, construction, business services, leasing…) for more than S/ 700: the customer deposits the percentage into your Banco de la Nación account and pays you the rest.
notas: `tipo_operacion` **1001** (subject to detracción; 1002 hydrobiological resources, 1003 passenger transport, 1004 freight transport, which set code 004/028/027). With 1001–1004 the detracción is mandatory (3127) and with any other type it is forbidden (3128).
`codigo_bien_servicio` from catalog 54 and `porcentaje` according to the current SPOT table for that good/service (khipu does not enforce it: check RS 183-2004 and its amendments).

`monto` always in **soles**: in PEN invoices you can omit it and khipu calculates it (total × %, rounded to the sol, as SPOT requires); in USD/EUR you must send it converted at the day’s exchange rate.

`cuenta_banco_nacion` is the issuer’s detracciones account; it can be omitted if the company has it configured (`PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales` or the portal’s Company page), otherwise `422 DETRACCION_INVALIDA` (3034). `medio_pago` from catalog 59 (default `001` account deposit).

The detracción does not change the totals: the response carries `detraccion` with the catalog description and the amount; the XML carries `PaymentMeans`/`PaymentTerms` with the `Detraccion` indicator and legend 2006.
**1002 hydrobiological resources** and **1004 freight transport** also require sector data on each item: see the next two cases.

hidrobiologicos.cuando: You sell fish or other hydrobiological resources with detracción (code 004): SUNAT requires on each item the vessel, the species, the landing place and date and the quantity (fields 107–112).
notas: With `tipo_operacion` 1002 the `codigo_bien_servicio` must be `004` (rule 3129) and **each item** carries a full `hidrobiologico`: `matricula` (1–15 characters), `nombre_embarcacion` (≤100), `especie` (≤150), `lugar_descarga` (≤100), `fecha_descarga` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and `cantidad` in tonnes (up to 2 decimals). If any is missing, `422 DETRACCION_INVALIDA` with the rule (3063, 3130–3135).

In the XML they go as `cac:AdditionalItemProperty` with concepts `3001`–`3006` from catalog 55: the date in `UsabilityPeriod/StartDate` and the quantity in `ValueQuantity` with `unitCode="TNE"` (rule 3115). Legend 2006 is added automatically (4265).
`hidrobiologico` is not accepted in other operation types. The response and the portal’s detail show the vessel data per item.

transporte-carga.cuando: You provide road freight transport with detracción (code 027): SUNAT requires on each item the origin and destination with ubigeo, the trip detail and the three reference values of D.S. 010-2006-MTC (fields 113–118); legs and vehicles are optional (119–127).
notas: With `tipo_operacion` 1004 the `codigo_bien_servicio` must be `027` (3129) and **each item** carries `transporte` with `origen` and `destino` (`ubigeo` from catalog 13 and a `direccion` of 3–200 characters: 3116–3119), `detalle_viaje` (3–500: 3120) and `valor_referencial` with the three amounts in soles —`servicio` (01), `carga_efectiva` (02) and `carga_util_nominal` (03)—, which SUNAT requires exactly once each (3122–3126, 3208). If any is missing, `422 DETRACCION_INVALIDA` with the rule.

`tramos[]` and their `vehiculos[]` are optional (only observations 4200, 4270–4278): origin/destination ubigeos of the leg, `descripcion` (3–100), `valor_carga_efectiva`, `valor_carga_util_nominal` (with more than one vehicle), and per vehicle `configuracion` (D.S. 058-2003-MTC, no spaces), `carga_util_tm` and `carga_efectiva_tm`.

In the XML: `cac:Delivery` per line with `DeliveryLocation` (destination), `Despatch` (detail and origin), three `DeliveryTerms` (01/02/03 in PEN) and `Shipment/Consignment` per leg with `TransportHandlingUnit` per vehicle. `transporte` is not accepted in other operation types.

retencion.titulo: With IGV withholding (customer is a withholding agent)
retencion.cuando: Your customer is a withholding agent designated by SUNAT: it withholds 3 % of the total amount and pays it to SUNAT on your behalf. It is reported in the invoice; it does not change the totals.
notas: `retencion_igv: {}` is enough: khipu applies the legal 3 % rate on the total amount (`porcentaje` and `monto` are optional; if you send `monto`, it must match base × % within ±1, rule 3263).
The response carries `retencion_igv.monto` and `neto_cobrar` (total − withholding). If the invoice is on credit, set `monto_pendiente` = net to collect.

XML: global `cac:AllowanceCharge` with `ChargeIndicator false`, code **62**, factor 0.03, amount and base = total amount (rules 3114, 3262–3264). SUNAT also checks that the customer is in the withholding agents register and you are not (3262/3269): that cannot be validated locally.

percepcion.titulo: With IGV perception (you are a perception agent)
percepcion.cuando: Your company is designated a perception agent (domestic sale of goods in the annex, fuels) and collects the perception on top of the invoice amount.
notas: It requires `tipo_operacion` **2001**, **cash** payment and **PEN** currency (rules 3308, 3330, 2788); with 2001 in cash the perception is mandatory (3093).

`regimen` from catalog 53: `51` domestic sale (2 %), `52` fuel (1 %), `53` agent with a special rate (0.5 %). The rate is set by the regime (catalog 22); `base` (by default the total amount) and `monto` are optional and validated with a ±1 tolerance (2797, 2798).

The document’s amount to pay (`totales.total`) does **not** include the perception; the response carries `percepcion.total_con_percepcion`, which is what you collect from the customer, and the XML carries the `AllowanceCharge` 51/52/53 (`ChargeIndicator true`), a `PaymentTerms` with the `Percepcion` indicator and legend 2000.

anticipos.titulo: Advance payments (advance invoice and final invoice)
anticipos.cuando: The customer pays in advance (fully or partially) before delivery: first an invoice for the advance payment is issued and, on delivery, the final invoice for the whole operation deducting what was already paid.
notas: `anticipos[].serie` and `numero` identify the advance payment invoice (series `F###`, type 02) or receipt (series `B###`, type 03); a final receipt also accepts them, from the same buyer: it must be from this same company, to the same customer, in the same currency and be `ACEPTADO` or `ACEPTADO_CON_OBS` (SUNAT looks it up in its records: rule 3218). If not, `422 ANTICIPO_INVALIDO`.

`monto` is the **value without IGV** being settled (3000.00 in the example). khipu calculates the amount paid with IGV (3540.00); it cannot exceed what was invoiced in the advance payment nor what is invoiced in this invoice for the same tax treatment.

`afectacion` (optional): `gravado` (code 04, default), `exonerado` (05) or `inafecto` (06). It decides which base it is deducted from: a taxable advance payment reduces the IGV base (rules 3277, 3291); an exempt/non-taxable one reduces that base without IGV.

Example calculation: operation 10000.00 + IGV 1800.00 = 11800.00; advance payment 3000.00 → taxable base 7000.00, IGV 1260.00; `total_anticipos` 3540.00; `total` to pay 11800.00 − 3540.00 = 8260.00. `total_valor_venta` and `total_precio_venta` remain the gross amounts (10000.00 and 11800.00, rules 3278/3279).

In the XML each advance payment goes as `AdditionalDocumentReference` (type 02 or 03 depending on the series, issuer’s RUC, payment identifier), `PrepaidPayment` (amount with IGV) and `AllowanceCharge` 04/05/06; the totals carry `PrepaidAmount` (rules 2503, 2509, 3211–3220, 3282, 3287).

A 100 % advance payment leaves base, IGV and total at 0.00: the final invoice is still mandatory to document the delivery. With credit payment, `monto_pendiente` and the installments are validated against the balance after advance payments.
The response returns `anticipos[]` with `comprobante`, `monto`, `importe_pagado`, `afectacion`, `codigo_sunat` and `fecha_pago`, and in `totales` the `total_anticipos` field.

isc-icbper.cuando: Goods subject to the Selective Consumption Tax (alcoholic drinks, soft drinks, fuels, vehicles, cigarettes…) or plastic bags (ICBPER, a fixed amount per bag depending on the year).
notas: `isc.sistema` from catalog 08: `01` ad valorem carries `tasa` (%) on the sale value; `02` fixed amount carries `monto_unitario`; `03` ad valorem on the retail price carries `tasa` and `base_pvp` (suggested unit retail price without IGV: beers, cigarettes, soft drinks), and the ISC base in the XML is `base_pvp × cantidad`, not the sale value (rule 3108). `precio_unitario` always includes ISC and IGV: khipu separates value, ISC and IGV (159.30 = 100 × 1.35 × 1.18; 3.599 = (2.00 + 3.50 × 30 %) × 1.18). `base_pvp` cannot be less than the unit value.
ISC is part of the IGV base (rule 204) and is reported in a `TaxSubtotal` 2000 per line (with `TierRange` = system) and globally (rules 3108, 2373, 3210).

`icbper: true` marks plastic bags: one bag per unit (`unidad` NIU), fixed amount in force per year (S/ 0.50 since 2023, Law 30884) included in the price; it is reported as tax 7152 with no base or rate (rules 3236–3238).

With `icbper: true` the `cantidad` is the number of bags: an **integer from 1 to 99999** (`422 ITEM_INVALIDO` with 2892 if it is 1.5 or 100000, without rounding it) and the `unidad` is **NIU**: ICBPER is the amount per bag × `cantidad`, so with dozens or kilos you would undercharge. SUNAT only flags that unit (4320, on the `BaseUnitMeasure`, which khipu always issues as NIU); khipu rejects it in a new document (`422 ITEM_INVALIDO`), not in the full note that copies one already issued. `precio_unitario` includes ICBPER, so it must exceed it (0.50 per bag in 2023 or later): otherwise the line’s sale value ends up at `0.00` and it is rejected with 2370. A receipt with `tipo_operacion` `0113` (NRUS) does not accept `icbper` (3240).
The response carries per item `isc {sistema, tasa, monto, base, base_pvp}` and `icbper`, and in `totales` `isc` and `icbper`; `total_precio_venta` includes them (rule 55).

otros-tributos-placa.cuando: A line carries a sector-specific tax on top of IGV (tax 9999 «OTROS», for example a per-tonne charge or a municipal tax with a percentage rate) or the sale is fuel and the vehicle plate is reported (property 7000, catalog 55).
notas: `otros_tributos.tasa` is a percentage (up to 3 integer digits and 5 decimals, rule 3102) on the line’s **sale value** (rule 3109). It is reported as `TaxSubtotal` 9999 per line and globally, with no IGV treatment (3050).

`precio_unitario` includes IGV (and ISC, if any) but **not** the other taxes: they are charged on top. They do not enter the IGV base; they do add to `total_precio_venta` and to `total` (rule 3279). In the example: value 100.00, IGV 18.00, other taxes 3.50, total 121.50.

They are not accepted on free or export lines (3223, 3107), and cannot yet be combined with a global discount (02) or a global charge (49) that affects the base: `422 OTROS_TRIBUTOS_INVALIDO`. They work in receipts (the daily summary reports them) and a full note keeps them.
`placa` (up to 8 characters) goes as the item’s property 7000 («Gastos Art. 37 Renta: Número de Placa»); an empty plate or one of more than 8 characters responds `422 ITEM_INVALIDO` (3064).
The response carries per item `otros_tributos {tasa, monto}` and `placa`, and in `totales` `otros_tributos`.

ivap.cuando: You sell milled rice: the first sale in the country is subject to the Milled Rice Sales Tax (Law 28211), 4 % instead of IGV. Mills, traders and any issuer selling milled rice.
notas: `tipo_afectacion_igv: "17"` (catalog 07): `precio_unitario` includes IVAP (3.12 = 3.00 + 4 %). khipu calculates tax `1016` at 4 % per line and in its own global subtotal, and adds legend `2007` (Operación sujeta al IVAP).

The whole document is IVAP: SUNAT calculates its sale price **without IGV** (field 55), so it does not accept `10`, `20`, `30` or free items in the same invoice (`422 AFECTACION_INVALIDA`); the other sales go in another document. Nor does it accept `isc` or `icbper` on the line (rules 2650, 3223).
The reduced rate of the restaurants and hotels register does not apply to IVAP: the line always carries `Percent 4.00`.

The response carries in `totales` `gravado` (IVAP base), `ivap` and `igv` at 0.00; `total_precio_venta` = base + IVAP. Credit notes on an IVAP invoice are limited by its base and IVAP (rule 3503, tax 1016).

exportacion.cuando: You sell to a foreign customer: goods leaving the country (DAM) or services used outside Peru. Without IGV (tax 9995) and in the agreed currency; the invoice supports the export before SUNAT and Customs.
notas: `tipo_operacion` from catalog 51: `0200` goods, `0201` services provided entirely in the country (SUNAT requires being in the Register of service exporters, rule 3097), `0203`/`0204`/`0206`/`0207` services to shipping companies, ships, cargo and ZED, `0208` services provided partly abroad. `0202` (lodging) and `0205` (tour package) require the guest’s data and are not supported yet.

All items carry `tipo_afectacion_igv: "40"` (rule 2642) and `precio_unitario` is the sale value, without IGV; they are not mixed with `10`/`20`/`30`/`17` or free items and do not carry `isc`/`icbper` (3107, 3223): `422 AFECTACION_INVALIDA`. The response carries `totales.exportacion` and `igv` 0.00.

`cliente`: the foreign customer’s catalog 06 document —`0` non-resident tax document without RUC, `1` DNI, `4` foreigner’s card, `7` passport, `A`…`G`— and `pais` (ISO 3166-1, catalog 04) required. A RUC (`6`) is not accepted in `0200`/`0201`/`0204` (rule 2800): `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`.

`exportacion.incoterm` (EXW, FCA, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP) goes in `cac:DeliveryTerms`: SUNAT does not validate it, Customs does ask for it. In `0201`/`0208` `exportacion.pais_uso` is required (country where the service is used, other than PE, rules 3098/3099); in the other types it is not accepted.

Credit payment, discounts that do not affect the base (`03`) and charges `46`/`50` work the same; discount `02` and charge `49` do not (there is no taxable base). No detracción or perception (they do not apply to exports). Credit notes inherit the invoice’s operation type, currency, Incoterm and buyer.

boleta-dni.titulo: Receipt to a buyer with DNI
boleta-dni.cuando: Sale to an end consumer (a person, or a company that does not ask for an invoice). It is issued through the same endpoint as the invoice: the letter `B` of the series decides it is a receipt (type 03).
notas: The `B###` series is registered with type **03** (`POST /v1/series` or the Series page; registering it as an invoice, `01`, responds `422 SERIE_INVALIDA`, and issuing with a `B` series not registered as a receipt —unregistered, or registered as a `07`/`08` note— responds `422 SERIE_NO_CONFIGURADA`). Items, prices with IGV, tax treatments, discounts, charges, free items, ISC/ICBPER and IVAP work the same as in the invoice; the response is the same document with `tipo: "03"`.

`cliente`: any catalog 06 document. DNI (`1`) of **8 digits** (4207), RUC (`6`) with check digit (2017), foreigner’s card (`4`), passport (`7`) and the others up to 15 characters without spaces (4208). SUNAT only flags 4207/4208; khipu rejects them (`422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`) so as not to issue to a wrongly identified buyer. `razon_social` is the buyer’s name: from 3 to 1500 characters not counting leading and trailing spaces (2022).

What the receipt does not accept: credit sale (`FORMA_PAGO_INVALIDA`), IGV withholding (`RETENCION_INVALIDA`): `tipo_operacion` only `0101` (default), `0113` (NRUS), `0200`–`0208` export (without `0202` or `0205`), `0401` (non-residents), `1001`–`1004` (detracción) or `2001` (perception); another one responds `422 TIPO_OPERACION_INVALIDO` (3206). In exports and in `0401` the buyer has no RUC (`422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`, 2800): use their foreign document, their DNI or, in soles and up to S/ 700, «sin documento». Everything is rejected before using up a number.

**Deadlines** (calendar days from `fecha_emision`): khipu sends it **on its own** (`sendBill`, with its own CDR) in the same call, like an invoice, up to the **5th day**; on the 6th and 7th it reports it in a daily summary (see “Receipt sent after the 5th day”). A `fecha_emision` more than 7 days back responds `422 FECHA_INVALIDA` (1079).
It is voided with `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/baja` (see “Void a receipt”) and corrected with a `BC##`/`BD##` note (see “Credit and debit notes on a receipt”).

boleta-sin-documento.titulo: Receipt without the buyer’s document (up to S/ 700)
boleta-sin-documento.cuando: Small sale to a consumer who does not give their document: corner shops, restaurants, walk-in sales. SUNAT allows it only up to S/ 700.00 total amount.
notas: `tipo_doc` and `num_doc` both go as `-` (no document, catalog 06); a `tipo_doc` `-` with a number responds `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`.

In **soles**, or in another currency with `tipo_cambio`, and with a total amount (`totales.total`, with IGV, converted to soles) of up to **S/ 700.00**. Above that, or in another currency without `tipo_cambio` (there is no way to compare it with the cap), `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`: identify the buyer with their document, as in the previous case. It is validated before using up a number.

The name is also required without a document and has at least 3 characters (2022, an error at SUNAT from 2027-01-01): use `CLIENTES VARIOS`. A shorter name (`-`, `CV`) responds `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`.
Otherwise it is a receipt like the previous one: same deadlines, same voiding. Its notes take this same buyer without a document.

boleta-alta-tardia.titulo: Receipt sent after the 5th day (reported in the daily summary)
boleta-alta-tardia.cuando: A receipt issued with `enviar_automatico: false` that is sent late, or that stayed in `ERROR_ENVIO` until after the 5th day. SUNAT no longer accepts it on its own (1079): khipu reports it in a daily summary with its line in status 1 (new).
notas: There is nothing different to do: the same `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/enviar`, the automatic retry of an `ERROR_ENVIO` or issuing with a `fecha_emision` 6 or 7 days back decide the channel on their own. The summary (`SummaryDocuments`, `RC-yyyymmdd-N`) travels through `sendSummary`: if SUNAT already answered the ticket, the receipt comes back `ACEPTADO`; if not, it stays `ENVIADO` and khipu checks again.

The summary comes in the response’s `baja` and in `GET /v1/facturas/{id}/bajas`, with `condicion: "ALTA"` (in a voiding it is `BAJA`). Late receipts **with the same issue date** are reported together in a single summary, up to 500 lines: they share `identificador`, `ticket` and CDR, and each one carries its `linea` and the summary’s `lineas`. A voiding (`BAJA`) is always its own summary. If SUNAT rejects a multi-line summary (2987, one line with an error rejects the whole of it), no receipt ends up rejected because of that: each one is reported again on its own and only the faulty one ends `RECHAZADO`.

**The receipt’s CDR**: SUNAT does not issue a CDR per receipt within a summary; the receipt’s CDR is the summary’s (`El Resumen diario RC-…, ha sido aceptado`). `GET /v1/facturas/{id}` says so in `cdr.resumen` and `GET /v1/facturas/{id}/cdr` in the `X-Cdr-Resumen` header; the file is still named `R-<RUC>-03-<serie>-<número>` so as not to change what integrators already use, but its content is the summary’s. A receipt sent on its own (on time) has its own CDR and carries neither the field nor the header.

**Up to the 7th day** (`fecha_limite_envio`) it is on time. **After the 7th day** it is not lost: it goes anyway, in a summary separate from the ones on time (they are not mixed) with `fuera_de_plazo: true`. SUNAT does not reject it: the rules provide that it flags it with **4443** («El comprobante fue informado fuera del plazo establecido»), and then the receipt ends up `ACEPTADO_CON_OBS`; in the test against its test environment (e-beta, 8 and 30 days late) it accepted it with no observations and it ended up `ACEPTADO`. What rules is the document’s `cdr.observaciones`, not `fuera_de_plazo`. The sale is reported, but late: send receipts on time. SUNAT counts the deadline up to the day it receives the summary.
A receipt reported late is already past the 7 days for voiding (2957): it is not voided, it is corrected with a credit note.

The same applies to a note on a receipt, except credit note **10** and debit note **03**, which do not go in the daily summary: after the 5th day they end up `FUERA_DE_PLAZO` (1079) and sending responds `409 FUERA_DE_PLAZO`.

notas.cuando: Correct or cancel an invoice already accepted: returns (full or per item), later discounts, cancellation due to an error, rescheduling installments (credit note); late-payment interest, penalties or value increases (debit note).
notas: `tipo` **07** credit note / **08** debit note; `serie` registered with that type and starting with `F` (e.g. `FC01`, `FD01`; rule 1001; on a receipt, `B`: see the next case). `documento_afectado` must be an invoice of the company **accepted** by SUNAT and not voided (rules 2119, 2120); the note takes its customer, currency and operation type, and its date cannot be earlier (2885).

`motivo` from catalog **09** (credit note: `01` cancellation, `02` error in the RUC, `04`/`05` discounts, `06`/`07` returns, `09` decrease, `13` installment correction…) or **10** (debit note: `01` late-payment interest, `02` value increase, `03` penalties…); `descripcion` is the justification (1–500 characters, rule 2135).

**Full note**: without `items`, khipu copies the invoice’s items, global discount and charges (do not send your own `descuento_global` or `cargos`: they are rejected). If the invoice settled advance payments, send `items` for the net amount: advance payments do not travel in a note. If the net is 0.00 (the advance payments cover the invoice) no note is possible, because SUNAT rejects zero lines and a note for more than the total: it is voided with the voiding communication. **Partial note**: send `items` with the same format as in the invoice (e.g. one laptop of the two invoiced). A credit note never exceeds the invoice amounts, neither in total (3286) nor per tax (3503), and khipu deducts what previous credit notes already credited: several partial ones can add up to the invoice, but a second full note is rejected (SUNAT would accept it, because it compares note by note). A debit note has no cap.

**Discounts and charges in a note**: SUNAT does not accept `AllowanceCharge` in a note and requires each line’s value to be unit value × quantity (3271) and the IGV base to be the sum of the lines (3277). khipu applies the discount (`00`/`02`) and the charge (`47`/`49`) to the line’s value —the global one, spread across the taxable lines— and the note goes out without them: the base, the IGV and the total are the same, but the discount detail does not travel and the line’s unit value is the net one. A full note of an invoice with discounts adds up to the same as the invoice. A discount that does not affect the base (`afecta_base_igv: false`, codes `01`/`03`) does not fit in a note (3280: the note’s total does not subtract discounts) and responds `422 DESCUENTO_INVALIDO` before numbering: give the note’s `items` at their net amount. Charges that do not affect the base (`48`, `46`, `50`) do go.

**Credit note 13** (reschedule installments of a credit invoice): send `forma_pago` on credit with the corrected installments; the note goes out with amount 0 (rule 3315; `items` is ignored) and the installments are validated against the invoice (3320, 3321). In any other note `forma_pago` is rejected.

**Retries**: if the network drops after the `POST`, repeat the same call with the same `Idempotency-Key` (see “Safe retry with Idempotency-Key”): it responds `200` with the same note, without duplicating it or using up another number. It works the same on an invoice and on a receipt.

The response is the same document as for invoices plus the `nota { tipo_afectado, documento_afectado, motivo, motivo_descripcion, descripcion }` block; query, XML, CDR and resending go through `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`…, and the invoice lists its notes in `notas[]`. In the XML: `CreditNote`/`DebitNote` with `cac:DiscrepancyResponse` and `cac:BillingReference`. Error `NOTA_INVALIDA` (422) with the SUNAT rule in the message. Certified in e-beta: full, partial and 13 credit notes and debit note.

notas-boleta.titulo: Credit and debit notes on a receipt
notas-boleta.cuando: Return or correct a sale to an end consumer already accepted: full return or of one product, cancellation due to an error, value decrease (credit note); interest or value increases (debit note).
notas: Same endpoint and body as on an invoice, with the letter **B**: the note’s `serie` starts with `B` (e.g. `BC01` for credit, `BD01` for debit, registered with type 07/08) and `documento_afectado` is a `B…` receipt of the company **accepted** by SUNAT and not voided (rules 2399, 2400, 2119, 2120). An `F` note on a receipt, or a `B` note on an invoice, is rejected with `SERIE_INVALIDA`.

The note takes the receipt’s buyer, which can be «sin documento» (`-`): no RUC is required. **Full note**: omit `items` and khipu copies the receipt’s; **partial note**: send the items being returned.

Reasons not accepted on a receipt: credit note **13** (the receipt has no installments, rule 3259) and credit note **04**, **05** or **08**: a discount or bonus to an end consumer is applied in the same receipt (RCP art. 10 num. 1.4; SUNAT only flags it with 4367, khipu rejects it so it does not pile up observations). Use `01`, `06`, `07` or `09` to return or correct the amount.

A credit note does not exceed the receipt: the total allows **S/ 1** extra (rule 3286, an error from 2027-01-01 and khipu already applies it) and each tax, S/ 1 (3503). As in the invoice, what previous credit notes already credited is deducted.

**Deadlines** (the receipt’s, calendar days in Lima time): on its own with `sendBill` up to the **5th day**; on the 6th and 7th, khipu reports it in a **daily summary** with its line in status 1 and the receipt it modifies (`cac:BillingReference`); after the 7th, also in a daily summary, **late**: SUNAT does not reject it and may flag it with **4443** (then it ends up `ACEPTADO_CON_OBS`; in e-beta it accepted it with no observations). Credit note **10** and debit note **03** do not go in the daily summary: they expire on the 5th day (`FUERA_DE_PLAZO`).

To void it, `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/baja` on the note: it goes in a daily summary (`RC-…`, status 3), never in a voiding communication (2310). The receipt lists its notes in `notas[]` of `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`.

liquidacion-compra.titulo: Purchase settlement (buying from someone without RUC)
liquidacion-compra.cuando: The company buys from a person without RUC —a farmer, an artisanal fisher, a gatherer— who cannot give it an invoice or a receipt: the company issues the purchase settlement (type 04) and withholds the IGV and the Income Tax.
notas: **Who is who**: the company is the buyer and the issuer; the `vendedor` is a person without RUC with a DNI (`1`), foreigner’s card (`4`) or passport (`7`). A seller with RUC is rejected (`422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`, 2800): they issue their own invoice or receipt. Their address is required (address, ubigeo from catalog 13 and `condicion` from catalog 60: `01` point of sale, `02` production, `03` extraction, `04` exploitation, `05` others), as is the `lugar_operacion`. The `L###` series is registered in `POST /v1/series` with type `04`.

**Withholdings**: the buyer withholds the IGV of the taxable lines and **1.5 %** of each line’s sale value as a payment on account of the seller’s Income Tax (tax 3000), and declares and pays them. That is why `totales.total` —and `liquidacion.neto_pagar`— is what is paid to the seller: subtotal − IGV − income tax + rounding (rule 4312). A taxable line’s `precio_unitario` includes IGV, as in the invoice; in the example, 100 kg at S/ 11.80: value 1 000.00, IGV 180.00, income tax 15.00, net 985.00.

Each line carries the **SUNAT product code** (`codigo_sunat`, catalog 25: required, 3506) and a tax treatment `10`, `20` (e.g. agricultural products exempt under Appendix I) or `30`. `tipo_operacion` `0501` domestic purchase (default) or `0502` advance payments. **Not yet**: gold purchase (`0503`, requires the mining right data), free purchases, other taxes (9999) and settling advance payments.

**Deadline**: SUNAT accepts it up to the **day after** its issue (2108); it has no daily summary. **Voiding**: SUNAT does not accept it in a voiding communication (2308) but in a reversals summary, which khipu does not issue yet: `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/baja` responds `422 BAJA_INVALIDA`.

That the DNI exists, does not belong to a minor or a deceased person (2450, 2460–2462) and that the seller does not exceed **75 UIT** of sales through purchase settlements in the year (2451) is validated by SUNAT with data khipu does not have: if it fails, the settlement ends up `RECHAZADO` with the number used up.

Query, XML (`SelfBilledInvoice` UBL 2.1), CDR, PDF and resending go through `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`…; the listing filters it with `tipo=04`, and `POST /v1/liquidaciones-compra/calcular` responds with the amounts without issuing. It accepts `Idempotency-Key`. Certified in e-beta: taxable, exempt and non-taxable, in dollars and by advance payment (`0502`) with a foreigner’s card.

comprobante-retencion.cuando: The company was designated by SUNAT as an IGV withholding agent: when paying a supplier’s invoices it withholds 3 % and issues the withholding certificate (type 20). Only for companies that khipu support enabled with the designation resolution.
notas: **Who can**: only a company designated as a withholding agent by SUNAT. khipu does not query the registers: support records the designation after checking the resolution; without it the `R###` series (type `20` in `POST /v1/series`) and issuing respond `422 AGENTE_NO_DESIGNADO` (2617). The `proveedor` always has a RUC, different from the company’s (2620).

**Amounts**: per document, withheld = payment × rate (and × exchange rate outside soles) and net paid = payment − withheld, **always in soles**. `totales.total` is the total amount withheld; `agente.importe_neto`, what is paid to the supplier. In the example, 3 % of 1 180.00: 35.40 withheld and 1 144.60 paid. A document in dollars carries `"tipo_cambio": { "factor": 3.756 }` (and its `fecha`, by default the payment’s).

`regimen` from catalog 23: `01` 3 % rate (the current one) or `02` 6 % rate, which only applies to documents issued up to 28/02/2014 (2985). Each document is an invoice (`01`), debit note (`08`) or ticket (`12`) with its payment; a document paid in installments goes once per installment, with another `pago.numero` (2626). All payments are from the certificate’s month (2625). **Not yet**: the credit note (`07`) and another withholding as a related document.

**Deadline**: SUNAT accepts it up to **7 calendar days** from the day after its issue (2600). It goes to SUNAT’s withholdings and perceptions service; a rejection does not use up the number for SUNAT, but khipu considers it used: fix it and issue another. **Reversal**: `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/baja` reverses it in a reversals summary (`RR-…`): SUNAT does not validate it against the issue; the rules require submitting it within 7 calendar days from when the reversal was communicated.

Query, XML (`Retention` UBL 2.0), CDR, PDF and resending go through `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`…; the listing filters it with `tipo=20` and it does not add to what was invoiced. `POST /v1/retenciones/calcular` responds with the amounts without issuing. It accepts `Idempotency-Key`. Certified in e-beta in soles and in dollars; e-beta does not check the agent designation.

comprobante-percepcion.cuando: The company was designated by SUNAT as an IGV perception agent: when collecting a customer’s invoices it collects an additional percentage and issues the perception certificate (type 40). Only for companies enabled with the designation resolution.
notas: **Who can**: only a company designated as a perception agent by SUNAT and enabled by support (otherwise, `422 AGENTE_NO_DESIGNADO`, 4285). The `cliente` can have a RUC, DNI or another catalog 06 document (2511, 2680).

`regimen` from catalog 22: `01` domestic sale 2 %, `02` fuel purchase 1 %, `03` perception agent with a special rate 0.5 %. Per document, perceived = collection × rate (in soles) and net collected = collection + perceived; `agente.importe_neto` is what the customer pays. The collected documents are invoices (`01`), receipts (`03`), debit notes (`08`) or tickets (`12`) of the company, collected in the certificate’s month (2612).

**What SUNAT validates with data khipu does not have** (e-beta does not apply it): that the collected invoice exists at SUNAT (2609) with its date (2610), is **on credit** (3329) and has not already reported the perception with operation type 2001 (3312). If the perception was collected in cash in the same invoice (`percepcion` in `POST /v1/facturas`), this certificate is not issued.

Deadline, reversal, query and downloads as in the withholding: 7 days (2600), `RR-…` (SUNAT does not validate its deadline against the issue), `tipo=40` in the listing, `POST /v1/percepciones/calcular` and `Idempotency-Key`. **Not yet**: exceptional issuing (`sac:ExceptionalIndicator`) or the credit note as a related document.

baja.cuando: Void before SUNAT an invoice, receipt or note already accepted that was issued by mistake (customer, amounts, duplicate) within the 7 calendar days after its issue. After the deadline, or if the document was already delivered, a credit note is the way.
notas: `{id}` is the document to void (invoice, receipt or note), which must be **ACEPTADO** or **ACEPTADO_CON_OBS** (2398) and have been issued **7 calendar days ago or less** (2957), counted in Lima time from the issue date, not from SUNAT’s acceptance: on day 7 it is accepted until 23:59, on day 8 no longer. It is the rule SUNAT applies to receipts and their notes from 2027-01-01 (RS 000048-2026; until then it counts from the CDR, which is never earlier than the issue): khipu already applies it and so meets both. SUNAT measures the deadline by the day it receives the communication: if sending fails (`ERROR_ENVIO`) and the retry reaches it after day 7, it rejects it with 2957 even if khipu accepted it (the retry resends the same `RA`/`RC`, with its original generation date); on the last day, request it early. `motivo` of 3 to 100 characters (2315). It responds **201** with the communication `{ id, identificador "RA-20260918-1", estado, ticket, cdr }`.

SUNAT processes voidings asynchronously: khipu sends the summary (`sendSummary`), receives a **ticket** and checks it (`getStatus`). If SUNAT already answered, the voiding comes back `ACEPTADA` (or `RECHAZADA`) in the same call; if it is still in process it stays `ENVIADA` and the worker checks it again after 30 s. Query `GET /v1/bajas/{id}` (it also checks the ticket again) or `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`, which carries the latest voiding in `baja`.

When SUNAT accepts the communication, the document becomes **ANULADO** and no longer accepts notes or resending. There can be only one voiding in progress per document; if SUNAT rejects it, it can be requested again. Error `BAJA_INVALIDA` (422) with the SUNAT rule in the message.
In the XML: `VoidedDocuments` (UBL 2.0, `RA-yyyymmdd-N`) signed like the documents; it is stored with its CDR. Certified in e-beta.
A **receipt**, or a note on a receipt, does not go in a voiding communication (2308/2310): it is voided through this same endpoint in a daily summary; see the next case.

boleta-baja.titulo: Void a receipt (voiding in the daily summary)
boleta-baja.cuando: Void before SUNAT a receipt, or a note on a receipt, already accepted that was issued by mistake, within the 7 calendar days after its issue. After the deadline, or if it was already delivered, a credit note is the way.
notas: Same endpoint, same rules and same cycle as voiding an invoice: **ACEPTADO** or **ACEPTADO_CON_OBS** (otherwise, `422 BAJA_INVALIDA` with 2663), issued **7 calendar days ago or less** counted in Lima time from `fecha_emision` (2957), `motivo` of 3 to 100 characters (2315) and a single voiding in progress.

What changes is the document: SUNAT does not accept receipts in a voiding communication (2308), so khipu voids it in a **daily summary** (`SummaryDocuments` UBL 2.0, `RC-yyyymmdd-N`) with the receipt’s line in status 3. The `identificador` starts with `RC` and the response carries `condicion: "BAJA"`. The reason stays in khipu: the summary does not carry it.

If SUNAT already answered the ticket the voiding comes back `ACEPTADA` and the receipt becomes **ANULADO**; if not, it stays `ENVIADA` and khipu checks it again (`GET /v1/bajas/{id}`). The number is used up: the corrected sale is a new receipt.

The receipt’s **free items** (bonuses, samples) are not reported in the summary: SUNAT accepts no code for them there (e-beta rejects `05` and `06` with 2256) and accepts the same summary without them. The summary carries what was sold; the amount to pay and the voiding do not change.
A receipt reported in a late summary (see “Receipt sent after the 5th day”) is already past the 7 days: it is not voided, it is corrected with a `BC##` credit note.

boleta-alcance.titulo: Receipt: what khipu covers compared to what SUNAT allows
boleta-alcance.cuando: Before integrating the receipt, to know which daily summary and buyer identification cases khipu covers and which are solved another way.
notas: **Daily summary in status 2 (modify): not implemented.** SUNAT allows it, but khipu only reports new ones (status 1) and voidings (status 3). An accepted receipt that went out with wrong data is corrected with a `BC##`/`BD##` credit or debit note, which is what the domestic rules recommend; that way the original document stays as SUNAT saw it and the correction leaves a trail.

**NRUS (`tipo_operacion` `0113`): it is issued.** The line carries the tax treatment and the IGV required by rules 3111, 2993, 4290 and 4310, and e-beta accepts the receipt. An `icbper` on any line of a receipt with `tipo_operacion` `0113` responds `422 ITEM_INVALIDO` (3240) because the NRUS taxpayer does not collect that tax. The invoice does not accept `0113`.

**Identifying the buyer: khipu validates the S/ 700.00 cap.** A receipt without a document (`tipo_doc` and `num_doc` as `-`) only goes through up to that total amount, in soles or converted with `tipo_cambio`. SUNAT also requires identifying the buyer when the receipt goes with a dispatch guide, in the Jungle region (from S/ 350.00) and in Tacna (from US$ 25.00). Those cases **are not validated**: khipu does not know the sale’s physical destination or the guide that goes with it. If your operation falls into one of them, always send the buyer’s document.

**Consolidated receipt of up to S/ 5.00: not offered.** The rules allow not issuing a receipt for each small sale and summarizing them in a single one per day, but it is a decision of your operation, not data khipu can deduce. Each sale is issued as its own receipt; if you need a consolidated one, issue it yourself as a receipt with one item per tax treatment (taxable, exempt, non-taxable) and a buyer without a document, and remember the total cannot exceed S/ 700.00 (`422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO`).

guia-remision-remitente.titulo: Shipper’s dispatch guide (09) in private transport — EXPERIMENTAL
guia-remision-remitente.cuando: You move the goods of a sale in your own vehicle and with your own driver. It is the guide issued by whoever ships the goods; the letter `T` of the series decides it is a shipper’s guide.
notas: **EXPERIMENTAL.** The contract with SUNAT’s REST API for the GRE comes from its manual and has not been tested against SUNAT yet: **sending is turned off** on the server and responds `422 GRE_NO_DISPONIBLE` before numbering until the operator turns it on after a controlled run. Meanwhile issue with `enviar_automatico: false` to review the XML and the PDF. The API’s shape may change.

**Requirements**: the `T###` series registered with type **09** (`POST /v1/series`), the certificate, the SOL credentials **and** the SUNAT API credentials (`PUT /v1/empresa/credenciales-api-sunat`, the `client_id` and `client_secret` of the application you register in SOL, option «Credenciales de API SUNAT»). The GRE goes through **SUNAT’s REST API**, not SOAP: without the API credentials, the guide is rejected before numbering (`422 CREDENCIALES_API_SUNAT_NO_CARGADAS`) except with `enviar_automatico: false`.

`motivo` from catalog 20 (`01` sale, `02` purchase, `03` sale with delivery to third parties, `04` transfer between branches of the same company, `05` consignment, `06` return, `07` pickup of transformed goods, `13` others —with `descripcion_motivo`—, `14` sale subject to confirmation, `17` transfer for transformation). Import (`08`), export (`09`) and itinerant issuer (`18`) not yet: `422 TRASLADO_INVALIDO`. In a sale the recipient cannot be the shipper itself (2555); in `04` it must be (2554), and the departure and arrival are branches of the company (3365, 3369).

`modalidad` **02** (private): `vehiculos` and `conductores`, the first of each list is the main one and up to two secondary ones (4389, 4376); plate of 6 to 8 letters or digits (2567), license of 9 to 10 (2573). With the `vehiculo_m1_o_l` indicator (cars or motorcycles) they are not needed. **01** (public): `transportista` with its RUC, business name and, optionally, `registro_mtc`, and without vehicles or drivers (2774) except with the `vehiculos_conductores_transportista` indicator.

`partida`/`llegada`: ubigeo (catalog 13) and detailed address; a branch of the company goes only with its code (`establecimiento`, from `GET /v1/empresa/establecimientos`; `0000` the tax address) and khipu fills in ubigeo and address. One that does not exist or was deregistered responds `422 TRASLADO_INVALIDO` (3366/3370). `fecha_inicio` cannot be before the issue date (3343) and `peso_bruto` goes in `KGM` or `TNE` (2880, 2881).

SUNAT processes the GRE asynchronously: khipu sends the ZIP, receives a **ticket** and checks it. The `201` response carries `estado` `ACEPTADO` if SUNAT already processed it, or `ENVIADO_PENDIENTE_TICKET` and khipu keeps checking on its own (increasingly spaced, for ~24 h; also `POST /v1/guias-remision/{id}/ticket`). If SUNAT did not answer it stays `ERROR_ENVIO` and is retried on its own; if it rejected the credentials or the file, `reintento_automatico: false`: fix it and resend with `POST /v1/guias-remision/{id}/enviar`.

Before calling SUNAT the guide moves to `ENVIANDO`: two simultaneous sends do not send the same number. One that stayed `ENVIANDO` without an answer (`409 ENVIO_EN_CURSO`) is resumed with `POST /v1/guias-remision/{id}/enviar?forzar=true` after 10 min and only after checking in SOL that it did not arrive. If SUNAT rejects the credentials, the company does not request the token again with the same ones for an hour (`422 CREDENCIALES_GRE_RECHAZADAS`); saving others releases it.

SUNAT does not publish a test API for the GRE: a company in `BETA` does not send guides (`422 GRE_NO_DISPONIBLE`), but it can issue them with `enviar_automatico: false` to review the XML (`GET /v1/guias-remision/{id}/xml`). The PDF (`/pdf`) carries the full shipment and the QR with the query URL SUNAT puts in the CDR.

guia-remision-transportista.cuando: You are a transport company and carry a shipper’s goods. The letter `V` of the series decides it is a carrier’s guide; it usually goes with the customer’s shipper guide.
notas: The `V###` series is registered with type **31**. It carries `remitente` (whoever ships the goods, it cannot be you: 2560) and their `registro_mtc` (required, 4391), and always the main vehicle and driver (2566, 3357). It does not carry `motivo`, `modalidad` or `transportista`: sending them responds `422 GUIA_INVALIDA`.

`documentos_relacionados`: the shipper’s guide it goes with (`09`), the invoice, the DAM or the transport authorizations from catalog 61 (`65`–`69`, `82`); those the catalog marks «solo remitente» (`49`, `71`–`78`, `81`) are rejected (3445).

Sending, ticket, retries, PDF and credential requirements: the same as the shipper’s guide (previous case). It is the **least backed** of the two: where the shipper and the MTC registration go in the XML has no source in the SUNAT documentation at hand.

guia.titulo: Guide to issuing invoices and receipts
guia.resumen: Everything you need to issue electronic invoices and receipts that are valid before SUNAT with a single call: what to send in each case, what khipu calculates for you, what it returns and how to act on each status or error.

pasos: **Create your account and your company** in the portal (RUC and business name). Start in the `BETA` environment: it is SUNAT’s certification, documents have no tax validity and you can test without risk.
**Upload the digital certificate** (`.p12`/`.pfx`) and the **SOL credentials** (secondary user) in *Company*. In BETA, SUNAT’s test ones work (user `MODDATOS`).

**Complete the tax data** in *Company* (or with `PUT /v1/empresa/datos-fiscales`): tax address with a catalog 13 ubigeo, which goes in each XML as the issuer’s address, and the detracciones account if you will issue invoices subject to SPOT.
**Create a series** in *Series*: for invoices (type 01, `F001`) or for receipts (type 03, `B001`).
**Generate an API key** in *API keys*. It is shown only once: keep it as a secret.
**Issue your first invoice** with the base case below against `{base}`. The response carries the SUNAT status and the links to the XML and the CDR.

**Go to production**: once SUNAT has approved your certification, ask support to change the company’s environment to `PRODUCCION` (the environment is set when the company is registered and the change is made by the platform). The URL and the API key do not change.

anatomia.intro: An electronic invoice or receipt is a signed UBL 2.1 XML, and both are issued with `POST /v1/facturas`: the series letter decides which. You send the business data; khipu handles the rest: sequential numbering, IGV and totals calculation, amount in words, catalogs, XML-DSig signature, validation against the official schemas, SOAP submission to SUNAT, reading the CDR and retries.
filas: Numbering series registered in the company.
`F` + 3 alphanumeric characters issues an invoice (`F001`); `B` + 3, a receipt (`B001`).
Omit it so khipu assigns the next one; send it if your system keeps the numbering.
`YYYY-MM-DD`, not in the future. SUNAT must receive the invoice within 3 calendar days; the receipt, on its own up to the 5th day and in the daily summary up to the 7th.

`0101` domestic sale (default), `1001` subject to detracción, `0200`–`0208` export (`40` items, foreign customer with `pais`; without `0202` or `0205`), `0401` non-residents and `2001` perception; a type khipu does not issue yet responds `422` before numbering — [catalog 51](/developers/catalogos#cat-51).

In a domestic sale invoice, `6` (RUC); in exports, the foreign customer’s document; in a receipt, any from the catalog, or `-` with no document (only in soles and up to S/ 700) —[catalog 06](/developers/catalogos#cat-06).
11-digit RUC; in a receipt, 8-digit DNI, the others up to 15 characters, or `-`.

Up to 150 characters; it does not go to the XML. With automatic sending turned on (`PUT /v1/empresa/envio-al-cliente`), they receive the PDF, the XML and the CDR when SUNAT accepts. Malformed: `422 RECEPTOR_INVALIDO` without using up a number.
With IGV included for taxable items; khipu derives the unit value and the IGV.
Send to SUNAT in the same call.
`true` by default; `false` leaves the document FIRMADO.
anatomia.nota: The codes come from SUNAT’s official catalogs. You can look them up in the [SUNAT catalogs](/developers/catalogos) section or through the API (`GET /v1/catalogos/07`, without credentials). A `tipo_operacion`, `tipo_afectacion_igv`, `tipo_doc`, `moneda` or `unidad` outside the catalog responds `422` before using up a number. Catalog 03 has the full UN/ECE list, with the most used units first.

casos.intro: Each case shows the exact JSON for `POST /v1/facturas` (or the endpoint it indicates) and the rules that apply. The invoice cases also hold for the receipt except for what its own cases say: buyer, accepted operations, deadlines and voiding.
casos.marcadosDespues: describe the planned contract so you can plan your integration; the API will reject them until they are available.

respuesta.intro: Every response comes in the `{sobre}` envelope. In a successful issue `datos` is the full document:
filas: Where the document is. `ACEPTADO` is the happy ending; see [all statuses](/developers/errores#estados).
`0` accepted · 2000–3999 rejected (fix and reissue) · 4000+ accepted with observations · 1000–1999 issuer error with no proof.
SUNAT’s official text. Observations do not invalidate the invoice, but you should fix the cause in the next one.
Only in `ERROR_ENVIO`: code and message of the communication failure with SUNAT; khipu retries on its own.
What khipu calculated: use it to reconcile with your system (SUNAT tolerance ±1).
Signature digest: it is printed on the printed representation and in the QR.
Downloads: signed XML, printed representation (PDF with QR and hash, available from `FIRMADO`) and CDR. `cdr` only appears when SUNAT issued the proof.

errores.intro: Errors carry a stable `codigo` to code against and a `mensaje` for people; when the rule is SUNAT’s the message starts with the official code, the same one SUNAT would return if the document had reached it:
errores.lista: The full list of khipu codes, SUNAT’s ranges and what to do in each case is in [Errors and statuses](/developers/errores).

webhooks.intro: Instead of polling `GET /v1/facturas/{id}` until SUNAT answers, register a URL and khipu notifies you with a signed `POST` every time a document changes status. They are registered from the portal (*API keys and webhooks*) or through the API; up to 5 per company.
registro: The URL must be `https` and point to a public server: an internal address (localhost, private networks, `169.254.x.x`) responds `422 WEBHOOK_INVALIDO`. khipu does not follow redirects.

**The signing secret** (`whsec_…`) is shown **only once**, when creating the endpoint or rotating it (`POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/secreto`, the previous one stops working instantly). Creating, changing, rotating and deleting require the portal session, not an API key: a leaked key must not be able to redirect the events. Listing and viewing the log work with an API key.
eventos: SUNAT accepted it and left observations (CDR 4000+); the invoice is valid.
SUNAT rejected it (2000–3999): fix it and issue a new one.
It could not be sent to SUNAT; khipu retries. It arrives when failures start, not on each retry.
The sending deadline passed: it has to be issued again.
An administrator stopped trying to send it.
webhooks.notaEstados: Transient statuses (`RECIBIDO`, `FIRMADO`, `ENVIADO`) are not published. An endpoint you turn off does not receive the events that happen while it is off; one that khipu pauses due to failures keeps storing them (up to 30 days) and sends them when it is reactivated. `GET /v1/webhooks/eventos` lists the names; `["*"]` subscribes to all of them.
webhooks.entrega: A delivery (the body goes on one line, exactly as it is signed)
cabeceras: The event, same as the body’s evento field.
The delivery id. **It does not change between retries**: use it to avoid processing the same event twice.
`t=<Unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`: HMAC-SHA256 of the secret over `t.cuerpo`.
webhooks.verificar: Compute `HMAC-SHA256(secreto, t + "." + cuerpo)` with the **raw body** —the bytes exactly as they arrived, without re-serializing the JSON— and compare it in constant time with `v1`. Discard the delivery if `t` is more than a few minutes old: without that limit, whoever captures a delivery could replay it. Respond `2xx` in less than 10 seconds and process the event afterwards.
reintentos: It is **at least once**: a retry (or a manual resend) arrives with the same body and the same `X-Khipu-Delivery`. The order between different events is not guaranteed; if it matters, compare with the current `estado` using `GET /v1/facturas/{id}`.

Any response that is not `2xx` (or a timeout, or a network failure) counts as a failure and is retried with increasing waits: 1 min, 5 min, 15 min, 1 h, 3 h, 6 h and 12 h; after the eighth attempt the delivery ends up `FALLIDA` and can be resent by hand.

After **10 failed attempts in a row** khipu turns off the endpoint (`pausado_motivo` says why) and notifies the account by email. Turn the endpoint back on with `PATCH /v1/webhooks/{id}` `{ "activo": true }` or from the portal; pending deliveries go out right away.

`GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/entregas` is the log (30 days): status, attempts, last HTTP code or error. `POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/prueba` sends a signed `webhook.prueba` event, and `POST /v1/webhooks/entregas/{id}/reenviar` repeats a closed delivery; both, like everything that writes, require the portal session.

sire.experimental: **Experimental: reconstructed format.** It follows Annex III of RS 000138-2023 (which sets only part of the fields) and the change log of the SIRE Client Application, and it has not yet been validated with the SIRE Validator Program (PVSIRE) or with SIRE: do not use it to replace a real proposal before validating it with PVSIRE.
sire.intro: SUNAT builds the proposal of SIRE’s Electronic Sales and Income Register (RVIE) from your electronic documents. khipu gives you two things to work with it: the period’s replacement file, built from what you issued, and the reconciliation of that register with the proposal you download from SIRE. khipu never writes to SIRE: you (or your accountant) upload the replacement file in SUNAT Operaciones en Línea.
archivo: A ZIP `LE<RUC><AAAAMM>00140400021112.zip` with the `.txt` of the same name: one row per document SUNAT has (accepted, with or without observations, or voided later), 40 fields separated by `|`, dates `dd/mm/aaaa` and amounts with 2 decimals in the document’s currency, with its exchange rate in field 28 (`0.000` in soles).
The credit note goes in negative and carries the document it modifies (fields 29–32) and its reason (34); a voided one goes with status `2` and amounts at zero; each receipt goes on its own row.

**It only covers what was issued in khipu** (header `X-Rvie-Alcance: solo-khipu`): replacing the proposal with it removes the sales issued by other means (SEE-SOL, paper documents, another provider). Before replacing, reconcile and require an empty `solo_en_sunat`.
What is still on its way to SUNAT is not included: the `X-Rvie-Pendientes-Sunat` header says how many there are. Wait for SUNAT to resolve them before using the file.

Errors arrive before the file, in JSON: `404 NO_ENCONTRADO` with no documents in the period and `422 RVIE_SIN_TIPO_CAMBIO` if there are documents in another currency without an exchange rate (with `permitir_sin_tipo_cambio=true` they come out with the field empty, to fill it in by hand).
sire.curlConciliar: cURL — reconcile with the proposal downloaded from SIRE
sire.conciliacion: The response says whether the register `cuadra` (matches) and, if not, which documents are only in SUNAT (`solo_en_sunat`), only in khipu (`solo_en_khipu`) or in both with a different value (`difieren`: date, currency, status, taxable base, IGV, exempt, non-taxable or total). It stores nothing.
sire.consolidadas: The proposal’s consolidated rows (a range of the day’s receipts in one row) are not reconciled one by one: they are counted in `filas_consolidadas_no_conciliadas`. Review the file with your accountant before replacing a proposal. If the reconciliation shows the same difference in all documents of one type (for example, all credit notes), it is the format and not your sales: let us know.
sire.propuestaSunat: **Without downloading or uploading anything** (experimental, off by default on the server: ask the operator). With the SUNAT API credentials of an application registered in SOL as “MIGE RCE y RVIE - SIRE” and the SOL credentials loaded, khipu asks SUNAT for the proposal: `POST /v1/sire/rvie/propuesta?periodo=AAAAMM` answers `202` with a `ticket`; `GET /v1/sire/rvie/propuesta/{ticket}?periodo=AAAAMM` says whether it is `EN_PROCESO`, `TERMINADO` or `CON_ERRORES`; and `GET /v1/sire/rvie/propuesta/{ticket}/conciliacion?periodo=AAAAMM` downloads what SUNAT prepared and reconciles it with the same report. It only reads: it replaces or accepts nothing in SIRE.
sire.curlPropuesta: cURL — ask SUNAT for the proposal and reconcile

buenasPracticas: **Idempotency:** if your system may retry a call (timeouts), send an `Idempotency-Key` (one UUID per document) in `POST /v1/facturas` and in `POST /v1/notas`: repeating the same request with the same key returns `200` with the same document, without issuing another. If you number yourself, `correlativo` also prevents it: a duplicate responds `409`. See [Safe retry with Idempotency-Key](#idempotency-key).
**Store the `id`** khipu returns along with your internal document; with it you query the status and download XML, PDF and CDR.

**Deliver the document to the customer** with `POST /v1/facturas/{id}/correo` `{ email, mensaje? }`: khipu attaches PDF, XML and CDR. Only accepted documents (`409 NO_ACEPTADO`); the PDF’s QR encodes `RUC|tipo|serie|número|IGV|total|fecha|tipo y nº de documento del cliente|hash`.

**Or have it go out on its own:** turn on `PUT /v1/empresa/envio-al-cliente` `{ "enviar_automaticamente": true }` and issue with `cliente.email`. When SUNAT accepts, khipu sends the email only once (a note goes to the email of the document it modifies; a receipt in the daily summary, when SUNAT accepts the summary) and retries up to 5 times if the mail server fails. `envio_al_cliente` in `GET /v1/facturas/{id}` says whether it went out (`ENVIADO`), is still `PENDIENTE`, ended up `FALLIDO` or `OMITIDO`, with the reason. Without email configured on the server it cannot be turned on (`503 CORREO_NO_CONFIGURADO`).

**For the accountant:** `GET /v1/facturas/exportacion?formato=xlsx` (or `csv`) with the same filters as the listing gives one row per document —type, series, number, date, customer, currency, exchange rate, bases, IGV, ICBPER, ISC, IVAP, other taxes, discounts, charges, advance payments, rounding, total, status and modified document—, up to 5000 per export (`422 EXPORTACION_EXCEDE_EL_TOPE`). Credit notes come out **in negative** (debit notes, in positive) and, without the `estado` filter, `RECHAZADO`, `INVALIDO` and `DESCARTADO` are left out. For Excel use `xlsx`; the CSV is UTF-8 with BOM, comma-separated (`separador=punto_y_coma` if your Excel asks for it), with a decimal point and a quote in front of texts that start with `= + - @`. If the connection drops, the file arrives incomplete: request it again.
**Do not poll in a loop:** register a [webhook](#webhooks) and khipu notifies you when SUNAT answers.

**Do not treat `ERROR_ENVIO` as a final failure:** it means SUNAT is unavailable; check the status later or force a resend. `RECHAZADO` is final: fix it and issue a new document, with another number. The rejected one keeps its own: on a 2000–3999 rejection SUNAT considers the number used, and khipu never reassigns a number (a repeated `correlativo` responds `409 DUPLICADO`).

**Deadline:** issue on the same day as the operation. SUNAT rejects invoices received more than 3 calendar days after the issue date (2108); a receipt goes on its own up to the 5th day, in the daily summary up to the 7th and after that it is reported late: SUNAT does not reject it and may flag it with 4443.
**Environments:** integrate and test everything in `BETA`; what SUNAT accepts in BETA it accepts in production under the same rules.
**Secrets:** the API key identifies your company; keep it in a secrets manager and revoke it from the portal if it leaks.
